上銀 26Q2 受惠於產品漲價效益顯現及 UTR 提升，單季毛利率攀
升至 34.17%。單季合併營收達 75.08 億元，QoQ 17.70% 、YoY 
26.71%。營業利益與稅後淨利分別大幅成長至 10.34 億元與 8.48
億元，帶動單季 EPS 攀升至 2.40 元。 
展望後市， 研究部對上銀營收表現維持正向看待 。 目前終端需求持
續暢旺，產品交期維持高位，線性滑軌能見度約 4 至 5 個月，滾
珠螺桿最長可達 6 個月 。 儘管地緣政治因素推升鋼材 、 包材與潤滑
油等原物料價格 ， 但公司具備彈性定價能力且維持多元採購策略，
漲價效益足以抵銷成本上揚。伴隨26Q3 完整反映漲價產品銷售，
預估單季營收達 80.92 億元，QoQ 7.77%，YoY 34.97%，EPS 上
看 2.81 元。放眼 2026 至 2027 年，亞洲半導體需求穩固、歐洲軍
工與航太產業接棒成為新動能 ， 整體訂單需求無虞 。 預估上銀2026
年與 2027 年營收將分別達 296.90 億元與 329.36 億元 ， 維持雙位
數年增幅，YoY 分別為 22.37%與 10.93%。在營運規模提升帶動
下，預估 2026 年、2027 年 EPS 將分別達 9.28 元與 11.87 元。 
評價方面，上銀過去五年 PER 主要集中於 20 倍至 40 倍區間。考
量公司營收與獲利將呈現雙位數成長上升趨勢，產業結構持續上
行，研究部以2027 年預估 EPS 11.87 元作為評價基礎，並給予歷
史區間中緣偏上之 35x 本益比，目標價為 420 元，給予「買進」
之投資建議。  
⚫   ⚫ 公司基本資料 
上銀科技(2049)成立於 1989 年，主要從事線性滑軌(GW)、滾
螺桿(BS)、工業機器人、機器手臂、迴轉工作台、減速機、精
密軸承及醫療設備之研究開發、設計、製造、銷售、維修及售
前售後服務，同時為全球第三大滾珠螺桿廠和線性滑軌廠，僅
次於日本 THK、NSK。公司以自有品牌 「HIWIN」 行銷全球，
海外子公司橫跨德國、美國、日本、瑞士、捷克、法國，

⚫ 全球需求延續，獲利有望持續成長，估 2026 年 EPS 9.28 元 
研究部對上銀後市營收維持正向看待，係因以下：(1) 終端需
求持續暢旺，產品交期維持高位； (2) 公司具備彈性定價能
力，漲價效益足以覆蓋成本上揚；(3) 半導體產業需求穩固，
持續帶動滾珠螺桿與機器人等相關產品出貨。 
訂單能見度方面，目前整體產品交期維持高檔，線性滑軌約  
4-5 個月 ， 滾珠螺桿最長可達 6 個月 。 觀察各區域下游需求：
亞洲市場維持暢旺，其中中國受惠於電動車、電子與半導體產
業持續擴張，帶動製造設備與傳動元件需求；東南亞受惠全球
供應鏈重組，除傳統傳動元件外， 亦間接推升機器人產品需
求；台灣則持續受惠半導體與科技業資本支出，帶動螺桿與機
器人穩健成長。歐洲市場方面，儘管德國汽車工業仍顯疲態，
但軍工與航太產業已成為新成長動能，加上捷克、波蘭等中歐
製造核心需求保持穩定，有效支撐歐洲營運。

Asia Vital Components (3017.TW)
07 September 2026 Citi Research

Asia Vital Components
Valuation
We value AVC using a PE-based approach that factors in earnings momentum and the expansion of its addressable market.
Our TP of NT$3,800 is derived from applying a 25x PE multiple on 2027E EPS, which we believe is justified given the
company’s entrenched positioned in the server thermal segment, rising contribution from liquid cooling, and the increasing

value of thermal content per server as power density continues to climb. With these structural drivers still in place, we expect
the multiple to hold at a premium relative to its historical averages.
Risks
This stock is High Risk based upon our quantitative model but assigning a High Risk rating is not supported by other
qualitative factors such as cold-plate leadership and deep CSP penetration, and so a High Risk rating has not been applied.
Key downside risks to our investment thesis and target price include: 1) slower adoption pace for liquid cooling adoption; 2)

heightened price competition; 3) lower-than-expected share in liquid cooling components; and 4) emerging alternative cooling
technologies.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.

call to indicate the analyst expects the share price to rise (fall) in absolute terms over a specified period of 30 or 90 days in
reaction to one or more specific near-term catalysts or events impacting the company or the market. A Catalyst Watch will be
published when Analyst confidence is high that an impact to share price will occur; it will be a STV when confidence level is

moderate. A Catalyst Watch or STV Upside/Downside call will automatically expire at the end of the specified 30/90 day
period. The Catalyst Watch will also be automatically removed if share price performance (calculated at market close) exceeds

Hiwin Technologies Corp.  | Asia Pacific
August Sales +1% MoM/+42%
YoY
In this report, we focus on Hiwin's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price.
Details:
• August sales were NT$2,708mn (+1% MoM/+42% YoY).
• QTD revenue was 67% of our 3Q26 estimate, at NT$7,996mn (+6% QoQ/
+33% YoY), and 68% of consensus, at NT$7,884mn (+5% QoQ/+32% YoY).
Our view:
• We think 3Q26 is tracking slightly ahead of expectations.

• Looking into 2H26, we maintain the view that Hiwin should continue to see
revenue growth amid the industry recovery and margin expansions driven by
higher utilization/price hikes.
• We stay constructive on the stock, with current valuation at 29x 2027e P/E
vs. a peak cycle level of 35-40x.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
Hiwin Technologies Corp. (2049.TW)
Base case, P/E. We think this valuation methodology better captures Hiwin's earnings growth
momentum, as its valuation tends to move with the business cycle. We apply a target multiple
of 38x to our 2027 EPS estimate. We view this multiple as justified by the 47% operating profit
CAGR we project for 2025-28.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger industrial automation demand pickup.

n Market share gains.
n Earlier-than-expected revenue contribution from humanoids.
Risks to Downside
n Weaker industrial automation demand.
n More pricing pressure.
n Market share loss.
n More broad-based impact on the global economy from geopolitical risks.

King Slide Works Co. Ltd.  | Asia Pacific
August Sales +1% MoM/+344%
Y oY
In this report, we focus on King Slide's monthly sales, which we
believe could be a catalyst for its share price movement.
Details:
• August sales were NT$6,466mn (+1% MoM/+344% YoY) – another record
high.
• QTD revenue reached 66% of MSe, at NT$19,555mn (+81% QoQ/+348%
YoY), and 77% of consensus, at NT$16,755mn (+55% QoQ/+284% YoY).
Our view:
• We see 3Q26 revenue tracking in line with our estimate.

• On top of the mainstream GPU/ASIC server demand from hyperscalers, we
believe that King Slide is generating more revenue from various projects in
different applications as well.
• We believe the company should continue to benefit from server market
growth and increasing dollar content, driven by more complex designs and
broader adoption of rail kits. We view it as a good proxy for the AI capex
cycle, given its dominant position, strong patent portfolio, and solid

execution.
• Stay OW.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
King Slide Works Co. Ltd. (2059.TW)
Base case, 30x 2027e P/E. We use price/earnings as our valuation methodology because we
believe it better captures King Slide's earnings growth potential. We believe our target mul-
tiple is justified by an operating profit CAGR of 77% seen for 2025-28, implying a PEG of 0.4
vs. the average of 1.2 over 2010-24, when the stock was trading at 17-18x P/E with an operating

profit CAGR of 14%.
Risks to Upside
n Stronger-than-expected AI capex
n Stronger server demand
n Faster market share gains
Risks to Downside
n Softer AI capex
n Weaker server demand
n Sluggish kitchen furniture demand
n Competition leading to slower share gains.

Quantum Security / eMemory:
Investor Feedback
Low investor expectations, mostly a teach-in – eMemory
remains under-owned and under-researched, so feedback was
largely educational rather than push-back; we see this as the
marketing opportunity.
Morgan Stanley Taiwan Limited+
Daniel Yen, CFA
Equity Analyst
Daniel.Yen@morganstanley.com                                                +886 2 2730-2863

Greater China Technology Semiconductors
Asia Pacific
Industry View Attractive
What we published – and the feedback. On 17 August we released the Global
Foundation “Hardware Quantum Security – Building Defenses for Q-Day and
Beyond” with our eMemory OW initiation (PT NT$3,330): as quantum computing
nears (base case ~2030), a new hardware-security layer must be deployed 3-5 years
ahead, with physical unclonable function (PUF)-based Root-of-Trust IP adding 5-10%

to the semi IP market. Feedback was constructive – clients agree the “Harvest Now,
Decrypt Later” risk and 2030-31 migration deadlines make this a multi-year, non-
binary theme. The recurring point –  and our marketing opportunity – is that  Aspeed
is already well-owned while eMemory stays under-researched by global funds.
Debate 1 – sizing the TAM. The key question is whether PUF is truly required once
post-quantum cryptography (PQC) arrives. We size a PUF-PQC TAM of ~US$310mn

by 2030 (base), US$600mn bull / US$190mn bear, on ~25% PQC adoption and
~50% PUF attach, with datacenter/AI servers the largest royalty pool. Once PQC is
implemented, secure key generation/storage makes PUF the logical anchor – so
sensitivity sits on PQC pace, not PUF attach. We view eMemory’s NeoPUF as best-in-
class: near-zero bit-error rate, lower area/power, and superior advanced-node scaling
vs. SRAM PUF.
Debate 2 – is eMemory the right proxy? Yes. The case rests on the core royalty

engine: royalties are the majority of earnings and tied to customer production, so as
mix shifts to leading-edge nodes, higher wafer values lift royalty per design-win.
Advanced-node projects are already >50% of licensing  non-recurring engineering
(NRE) revenue. This is corroborated by the just-reported August sales of NT
$357mn, +42.8% Y/Y (8M26 +21.9% Y/Y, 8th straight month of growth);
royalties were 60.8% of 2Q26 revenue (+7.8% Y/Y) and management guides for

royalty growth to accelerate into 2H26 on advanced-node ASPs and new apps (OTP,
NeoFlash/1T Flash, PUF-PQC). (Continued in the next section)

Key Takeaways
Under-owned, mostly a teach-in: feedback was largely educational, not push-back
– the marketing opportunity; clients called the level “a good entry point”.
August sales momentum: NT$357mn, +42.8% Y/Y; 8M26 +21.9% Y/Y (8th
straight month of Y/Y growth).
Reiterate Overweight, PT NT$3,330: ~30% further upside, plus free optionality

on a US$310mn base-case PUF-PQC TAM by 2030.

Our view and stock calls. Reiterate OW, PT NT$3,330 (~30% upside from NT$2,570) – a 
rare mix of a defensive, high-visibility royalty stream (100% gross margin, ~63% ROE) plus 
free optionality on the post-quantum build-out, alongside Synopsys (OW) and adopter 
Aspeed (OW). Catalysts: monthly-sales momentum, the advanced-node royalty ramp, PQC 
design-win news-flow and San Jose OCP in Oct 2026. Risks: 1) semi downturn, 2) PUF-PQC 
competition, 3) slower quantum/PQC adoption. Net-net, eMemory is an under-owned 
name where the royalty re-rating and quantum-security theme are both intact.

Valuation Methodology and Risks
eMemory Technology Inc (3529.TWO)
We derive our price target from a residual income model. We assume an 8.6% cost of equity
(2.0% risk-free rate, 6.0% equity risk premium, and 1.1 beta), a payout ratio of 90%, a medium-
term earnings growth rate of 23.0%, and a terminal growth rate of 4.4%. Based on these
assumptions, our RI model implies an equity value of NT$249bn, or NT$3,330 per share.

Risks to Upside
n Faster-than-expected PUF adoption
n Stronger-than-expected advanced-node OTP migration
n Higher-than-expected royalty expansion from wafer value growth
Risks to Downside
n Slower-than-expected adoption by key customers
n Slower-than-expected PQC adoption
n Increasing geopolitical and trade policy risks
Aspeed Technology (5274.TWO)
Base case, residual income model. Key assumptions:
n Cost of equity of 9.8% (2.0% risk-free rate, 6% risk premium, 1.3 beta)

n Medium-term growth rate of 21.4%
n Terminal growth rate of 5.5%
n Cash payout ratio of 85%
Risks to Upside
n Stronger cloud demand
n Faster-than-expected spec migration
n Mild competition
Risks to Downside
n Softening cloud demand
n Slower-than-expected spec migration
n Intensified competition
n Further policy tightening in China
Synopsys Inc. (SNPS.O)
The sector is trading on a 30-35x P/E multiple range. We expect Synopsys to trade in line and

apply a c.33x P/E multiple to estimated FY26 EPS ($15.12).
Risks to Upside
n Bigger ramp-up in AI ASICs and GPUs than modelled
n Quicker recovery in Automotive & industrial
n Design wins at expense of peers with Ansys products

Industry View Attractive
USI (601231.SS): ELSFP reinforces our confidence in USI’s optical roadmap.
EugenLight, USI’s photonics subsidiary, showcase its external laser source modules
(ELSFP) during CIOE. We believe EugenLight’s solution stands out on power

efficiency, 8 channel ELSFP around 12W, which should become increasingly
important as optical I/O scales and system-level power constraints tighten. More
importantly, we see ELSFP as a strategically important building block for the
migration toward NPO and ultimately CPO, where moving the laser source outside
the compute/package environment can improve overall system reliability. While
USI’s optical-module business has so far ramped below our earlier expectations

(link), our CIOE discussions suggest that the company has not fallen behind in
ELSFP , giving it another route to participate as architectures evolve beyond
conventional pluggables. Customer design in and production ramp are key things to
watch going forward.
ASMPT (0522.HK): Fluxless TCB addresses two key challenges in optical engine
packaging. Our key takeaway from CIOE is that optical engine  packaging faces two
critical manufacturing challenges – warpage and optical-port contamination –  both

of which could become more pronounced as OEs scale in size and complexity.
Compared with conventional mass reflow, thermo-compression bonding (TCB)
offers better control over the bonding process and can help mitigate warpage,
potentially improving assembly yield and reliability. Meanwhile, ASMPT’s fluxless
TCB solution, enabled by AOR (Atmospheric Oxide Removal), eliminates the need
for flux during bonding, thereby avoiding flux residue and reducing the risk of

contamination at sensitive optical ports. We believe these process advantages make
TCB particularly well suited for next-generation optical engine packaging and
strengthen ASMPT’s positioning as NPO/CPO architectures scale. (Continued)

### Page 2

M
 Update
2

Takeaways from other booths: Laser chip capacity expansion and higher power CW 
products were key themes, with Source Photonics outlining significant EML and CW 
capacity expansion for 2027, with its 200mW CW products targeted to support NPO in 
1Q27. Source Photonics also demonstrated an ELSFP for 6.4T application using its in-
house  CW lasers, with 8 outputs delivering ~112mW per channel. Yunling displayed 
200mW and 300mW chips, HiSilicon showcased a 400mW device, and Everbright 
launched a 400mW-at-50°C CW DFB chip. We believe customer qualification and 
sustained volume delivery remain key differentiators as product availability broadens. 
NPO optical-engine bandwidth is progressing from 3.2T to 6.4T, with exhibits from Source 
Photonics and Accelink, and to 7.2T in HiSilicon's integrated-light-source design. VCSEL 
also remains an active NPO route for short-reach applications with HiSilicon displaying a 
3.2T VCSEL NPO. 
Conference takeaways: Tencent outlined a roadmap targeting the deployment of a 512-
acceleratotor supernode using 3.2T NPO in 1Q27, followed by a feasibility assessment in 
2Q27. Alibaba's roadmap targeted 4Q26 mass production of 3.2T NPO modules and 
QFabric switches followed by 6.4T UPO production around mid-2027. Its 6.4T UPO, 
developed with Accelink, is set to be demonstrated at the Sep 2026 Apsara conference.  
Tencent and Alibaba highlighted scale-up as a key near-term opportunity for NPO, citing its 
balance of bandwidth density, power consumption, supplier openness and delivery 
readiness. Industry participants also argued that NPO could remain a viable long-term 
architecture rather than a transitional one. For scale out, pluggables may remain the 
favored solution for broad deployment by some industry participants. Huawei's roadmap 
has progressed from 50G VCSEL solution in its 384-accelerator A3 supernode to 100G 
VCSEL LPO solution for its A5 supernode up to 8,192 accelerators. HiSilicon showcased 
both 3.2T VCSEL NPO and 7.2T SiPh NPO with integrated CW sources as potential future 
architectures.

### Page 1

We hosted Repon’s management at our Asia Leaders Conference 2026 (Aug 31 - Sep 
2) in Hong Kong. Management remains positive on their servers rail kits business, 
driven by both general servers and AI servers, riding on the generative AI trend. The 
company’s positive tone echoes our positive view on AI servers supply chain, on 
which we raised our AI servers implied AI chips forecast by 14% / 22% / 14% in 
2026E-28E in June (report link) to +75% / 42% / 20% YoY in 2026E-28E, or 19m / 
27m / 32m in 2026E-28E. Capex estimates on leading US CSPs was also raised by 8% 
/ 27% / 25% in 2026E-28E to +76% / +35% / +8% YoY in 2026E-28E, or up to 
US$1.1tn by 2028E (report link). As we highlighted in our FII Chairman and Innolight 
Chairman visits takeaways, supply chain remains positive on rising AI investments in 
coming years, with spending across CSP , NeoCloud, Government, and Enterprise, and 
we are at an early stage of infrastructure spending and application development. 
End-customers are involved more in supply chain product development and capacity 
investment, also better reflecting real demand.  
Company profile: Repon (6584.TWO, not covered) is a leading rail kit supplier for AI 
servers, general servers, and home appliances. The company provides 2U rail kits for 
server clients, and has been gradually expanding its product line-up to 4U / 7U rail 
kits. As the early entrant of server rail kits, Repon has built deep partnerships with 
US CSP clients by offering customized services. 
Key Takeaways

1. General servers rail kits outlook: Management stated servers revenues 
contribution came down in 2Q26 vs. 1Q26 due to raw material shortage affecting 
customers’ procurement on rail kits for general servers; however, management sees 
their major CSP customer’s procurement recovering in 3Q26, and the next largest 
customer (also a leading US CSP) procurement is also recovering in September. The 
rail kits for next generation of general servers (powered by Intel’s Birch Stream 
platform) will also start shipment in 3Q26, supporting the revenues growth. 
2. AI servers rail kits outlook: Management remains positive and stated their rail

### Page 2

kits for the next generation AI server racks powered by NVIDIA is entering shipment in
late 3Q26, so is the rail kits for the next generation ASIC AI servers (air-cooling version)
for their major customer, and the rail kits for the liquid-cooling version should also start
shipment in 4Q26 with a majority ramp up in 1Q27. The rail kits for storage servers could
also show contribution in 1Q27, followed by rail kits for more ASIC AI servers, supporting

the growth ahead.

We hosted TECO (1504.TW, not covered) management at our Asia Leaders 
Conference 2026 (Aug 31 - Sep 2) in Hong Kong. Management is positive on their 
data center business, which includes construction services, products (e.g. 
transformer, busway, AC motor controls, etc.), and modular data center (MDC). 
Management remains positive on data center demand in Southeast Asia, highlighting 
a major CSP client’s 1GW (5-year) plan in Thailand, Malaysia, and potential in 
Indonesia in the future. The positive tone echoes our positive view on the AI 
infrastructure cycle, on which we raised our AI servers implied AI chips forecast by 
14% / 22% / 14% in 2026E-28E in June (report link) to +75% / 42% / 20% YoY in 
2026E-28E, or 19m / 27m / 32m in 2026E-28E. Capex estimates on leading US CSPs 
was also raised by 8% / 27% / 25% in 2026E-28E to +76% / +35% / +8% YoY in 
2026E-28E, or up to US$1.1tn by 2028E (report link). As we highlighted in our FII 
Chairman and Innolight Chairman visits takeaways, supply chain remains positive on 
rising AI investments in coming years, with spending across CSP , NeoCloud, 
Government, and Enterprise, and we are at an early stage of infrastructure spending 
and application development. End-customers are involved more in supply chain 
product development and capacity investment, also better reflecting real demand.  
Company profile: TECO (1504.TW, not covered) was founded in 1956, starting with 
motor manufacturing and is currently among the five largest industrial motor 
suppliers worldwide. The company mainly offers electromechanical systems, with 
three major business groups of Green Mechatronic Solutions, Intelligence Energy, 
and Air & Intelligent Life. Apart from its traditional motor business, TECO is 
expanding in new markets including ESCO low-carbon solutions, EV powertrain, 
offshore wind power, energy storage system and data center engineering. The 
company has built 700 MV of data centers in Southeast Asia. 
Key Takeaways

1. Data center business: Management remains positive on the business and stated 
they provide both construction services across power, cooling, and networking, and

### Page 2

related products (e.g. transformer, busway, AC motor controls, etc.). The company’s data
center business focuses on Southeast Asia, where a major customer (a leading US CSP)
announced a 1GW data center in Malaysia (announced in 2025), 1GW data center in
Thailand (announced in 2026), and potential new data center in Indonesia. Other than
leading US CSPs, the company also sees opportunities in sovereign AI, for example,
Japan is planning a 5-year 350mW AI data center, which could use MDC (modular data

center) for speedy deployment.
2. Modular Data Center (MDC) strength: Management highlights MDC saves AI data
center deployment time by ~50% to within 9 months, and reducing 15-20% capex, as it
moves most work into factory production, reducing onsite engineering. Modular Data
Center includes: modular IT server system, modular UPS system, modular power
distribution system, modular container genset system (power generation), and modular
cooling system, facilitating the AI data center deployment. The company’s product in

Malaysia is also for a leading US CSP , which one MDC could deliver 2.7mW.

ab 14 September 2026
Global Research
First Read
WIN Semiconductors
2026 Taiwan Summit: Optical and Infrastructure
to drive mid-to-long-term growth
Q326 revenue tracking in line with guidance
WIN Semi attended our 2026 Taiwan Summit on Sep 14th. August revenue of NT
$1,937mn (+2% QoQ and +31%YoY) is tracking at 65% of both UBSe/Street at +12%
QoQ. WIN Semi maintained its Q326F revenue guidance of low-teens QoQ  growth,
mainly driven by optical and infrastructure segments. It noted revenue outlook from

WiFi has improved from a previously flattish QoQ  to sequentially QoQ growth as a result
of stronger router demand, and cellular remains flattish. Management did not provide
Q426 guidance, noting that demand will partly depend on smartphone seasonality,
although it remains more constructive on the growth outlook for aerospace and non-
smartphone optical markets. In terms of  capex, WIN Semi budgeted NT$2-3bn of capex
spending in 2026, primarily for GaN and InP expansion.

Laser diode remains in qualification but photodiode ramp accelerates
Management noted that its CW lasers and EML remains under  qualification with more
meaningful revenue contribution from 2027 and beyond. While WIN Semi is engaging
with a broader customer base for laser diode than for photodiode, management noted
its near-term optical growth should be driven primarily by the ongoing photodiode
ramp, with volumes expected to increase sequentially both MoM and QoQ through

H226F and continue strengthening into 2027F. Management also noted that its 50G
and 100G VCSEL solutions are already in production, providing additional support for
non-smartphone optical growth. As a result, smartphone-related optical is expected to
decline from 60-70% of optical revenue historically to around 50% in Q326F as non-
smartphone optical applications expand. Management maintained its target for AI/
datacom revenue (driver, PIC, laser diode, photodiode, and etc) exposure to reach high-

single digits by end-2026, up from a low-single-digit contribution in 2025.
Rising aerospace content strengthens long-term growth outlook
Management remains constructive on the long-term outlook and its margin profile as
the business mix shifts toward higher-margin optical and aerospace applications.
Aerospace revenue has increased to over 30% of infrastructure revenue (Infrastructure
was 30-35% of total sales in Q226F), driven by expanding LEO deployments, direct-to-

cell connectivity, and rising RF content as additional frequency bands and advanced
phased-array antennas are adopted, as well as migration from GaAs to GaN platform.
Management views aerospace and optical datacom as key medium- to long-term
growth drivers, supporting a more diversified revenue mix and improved margin profile.
Valuation: Maintain Buy rating with a PE-based price target of NT$500
We rate WIN Semi with  BUY and  PT of NT$500, based on 40x 2027-28E average PE. We

believe WIN Semi is well positioned to capture rising infrastructure and optical growth.

Company Description
Established in 1999, WIN Semiconductors is a leading foundry for compound semiconductor
wafers globally, with 43k 6-inch wafer capacity per month as of end-2022. While it offers
different types of compound semiconductors (GaAs, GaN, InP, etc.), the GaAs compound
contributes the majority of its revenue. Its products are used to make signal power amplifiers

that customers use in networking equipment and communication devices, including base
stations and smartphones.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We value WIN Semi using PE relative to its historical trading range and peer average.
Investing in WIN Semi involves risks that include, but are not limited to, rapid technological
changes, increasing competition, exposure to macroeconomic cycles and uncertain
enddemand. Slower wireless technology migration and poor performances by customers

could also significantly affect WIN Semi’s fundamental performance. WIN Semi’s LEO satellite
customers may face execution challenges in launching satellites, which will impact WIN
Semi's infrastructure revenue growth outlook. On the other hand, its progress on developing
and qualifying the optical communication laser diodes will have significant impact to its
earnings outlook and market sentiment. Moreover, it is extremely difficult to project the

financial results of tech companies, since their operating models are highly volatile and
unpredictable.

Global Research
First Read
Advantech
UBS Taiwan Summit 2026 key takeaways: Four
growth engines to drive robust orders
Upbeat FY26 outlook reinforced
Advantech delivered a positive message at the UBS 2026 Taiwan Summit, backed by an
upward-trending monthly book-to-bill (BB) ratio and accumulating design win projects
in its major market in the US. The company continues to see solid order placement, not
impacted by higher pricing. Advantech's component sourcing further improved QoQ to

support robust order momentum. On profitability, Advantech can pass on over 70% of
component cost increases. Despite positive operating leverage, management noted
possibly higher opex due to restricted stock award (RSA) expenses, which have relatively
higher amortization during the first few years, starting in 2027.
Leading indicators support robust order growth
Advantech's sustained order momentum is not impacted by higher pricing, with no
signs of client double booking. Some clients even offer 100% down-payments seeking

Advantech's on-time delivery. Management sees an upward trending BB ratio, healthy
at less than 2x.  Pipeline visibility is further reinforced by North American design wins of
US$444m in H126. Orders are mainly supported by three major end applications: 1)
factory automation (particularly AMRs and cobots), semi equipment (front- and back-
end equipment), 2) healthcare, 3) green energy infrastructure.   Management expects
those and edge AI projects to be the major  order drivers in the next three to five years.

Margin pressure to ease as component headwinds subside
Advantech’s GM fell to 37.7% in Q226 due to escalating component costs, particularly
across tech inputs such as GPUs, CPUs, MLCCs, memory and PCBs. After initial price
hikes in Oct 2025, Advantech has maintained bi-weekly price adjustments for board
products and monthly adjustments for systems in 2026, allowing it to pass on over 70%
of cost increases. To mitigate supply constraints, Advantech has signed LTAs and

qualified more alternative component suppliers. It has also worked through specialized
PCB bottlenecks. Its supply sufficiency has further improved in Q326 vs. Q226.
Management maintained  guidance of flat QoQ GM and OPM for Q326, while remaining
confident the long-term GM will recover to its historical 39–40% range and OPM will
continue to trend upward, driven by expanding operating leverage.
Valuation: Raise price target to NT$782; maintain Buy

We raise our 2026-28E earnings, mainly to reflect: 1) stronger-than-expected top-line
growth; 2) lower GM on continued input cost pressure and time lags for price increases
to be reflected in its P&L; and 3) possibly higher opex starting in 2027 on RSA expense
amortization. The RSA was  approved by the board but not yet issued, pending
regulatory authority approval. We raise our price target from NT$744 to NT$782 and
reiterate our Buy rating on the solid top-line momentum.

Company Description
Established in 1981 and listed on the Taiex in 1999, Advantech is a world-leading Taiwanese
IPC supplier. Its product offerings involve embedded boards and chassis, industrial computers
and controls, and after-sales services with applications spanning manufacturing automation,

healthcare, transportation, energy and networking industries. To serve the global market, it
has three manufacturing sites in Taiwan, Japan and China and direct subsidiaries in 27
countries.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We base our price target for Advantech on 30x 2027E PE.
Industrial PC sector risks include: slower global economic growth; uncertain trade tariff
negotiations; higher interest rates that could result in weaker capex investment; readiness

and supply chain bottlenecks of IT technology that could slow project execution; currency
movement; and changes in component pricing that could bring downside to profitability.
In our view, key company-specific risks include: 1) slower-than-expected edge-AI product
adoption; 2) competition in the non-AI IPC segment, especially in China; 3) rising component
prices; 4) NTD appreciation against the USD; 5) slower macroeconomic growth that could
negatively impact overall capex allocation; and 6) demand growth that could attract more

new suppliers to join the market, which may intensify competition and possibly bring price
pressure.

Global Research
First Read
Delta Electronics
Add to APAC Key Call Buy - Taiwan Summit
reaffirms the AI Power opportunity
Capturing a robust industry TAM as the leading server power supplier
Delta affirmed a stronger growth profile as AI infrastructure now is over 50% of sales.
Our bottom-up model from our APAC Focus (link) estimates a 69% CAGR to US$91.1bn
AI server power TAM from 2025-2030 even moderating 2028-30 for hyperscale cash

flow and grid power constraints. We see a strong 2027 driven by +65% YoY accelerator
die growth, Rubin's ~60% higher rack power and AMD's move to rack-scale systems.
400V/800V becomes a larger driver in 2028-29 as rising power density outgrows low-
voltage distribution. We believe Delta is key beneficiary with its  broad grid-to-chip
portfolio helping sustain its ~40% share of a rising TAM.
Near-term supply constraints bottoming from Aug and accelerating into Q4.

Supply constraints on Power ICs have tempered Q3 growth from +15-20% QoQ to +10-
12% QoQ but should grow in Sep and accelerate to double digit QoQ in Q426 and
above seasonal Q127 (UBS +3% QoQ) into new ASIC/GPU platform ramps and more
supply. Management expects shortages to persist for at least the next several quarters
with demand accelerating faster than supply and the supply-demand gap likely
widening before narrowing but price hikes rebounding OpMs.

HVDC Adoption Appears Increasingly Inevitable.
HVDC production and shipments have begun and should be modest in 2027 before
ramping sharper in the following 1-2 years. As rack power rises from 140kW on GB300
to nearly 250kW on VR200 and potentially higher on Rubin Ultra, management expects
space and efficiency constraints to shift power systems out of racks and into side-car or
centralized architectures. Delta sees HVDC as the logical solution for power-loss,

thermal, and density challenges, with higher-voltage architectures offering multiple-
times higher value per watt than current solutions. Delta sees three hyperscalers
evaluating 400V, two adopting it for NVIDIA racks initially before converging on 800V.
Reiterate Buy and PT NT$2,750
Delta's stock has pulled back 36% since May following push-outs to NVIDIA's
architecture slowing the dedicated power rack ramp-up and elevating supply
constraints, pulling it back to 22x/17x 2026-27 EPS. We now see better entry with sales

ramping in H226, spec upgrades to ASIC power racks and Rubin at 60% higher TDP over
Blackwell and margins holding better than feared. The company should leverage its
strong product line, R&D and field support to participate in the key power architecture
transitions in the coming years moving the power stack out of the rack and also
developing emerging nascent technologies including SST for facility level power
transformation and rectification and fuel cells licensing Ceres for medium-term

opportunity to supplement the power grid constraint with alternative energy.

Company Description
Delta Electronics provides computer switching power supply solutions, as well as video display
and electronics components, for computers, smartphones, telecom and industrial products.
Founded in 1971, the firm has production bases in Taiwan, China, Thailand and India. In

2023, its power electronics, infrastructure and automation segments contributed 62%, 25%
and 13% of revenue, respectively.
UBS EPS and Consensus EPS
The UBS EPS is an adjusted diluted EPS metric. It is calculated using the UBS analyst's
interpretation of earnings suitable for valuation purposes divided by the diluted number of
shares. This may differ to the way the consensus EPS metric has been calculated.
Valuation Method and Risk Statement
We base our price target on PE multiple valuation.

Delta's businesses include SPS and components for a variety of end-applications, video
displays and data networking subsystem and system products. Any changes in these end-
markets could affect our forecasts for Delta. Investment risk could increase/decrease on any
deviation from our expectations for end-market demand and competition.
Downside risks for Delta include: severe supply chain constraints; weaker-than-expected PC/
server demand; a slower-than-expected IA recovery; and a slower ramp of 5G in 2022.

### Page 1

Poya  (5904.TWO)
Positives Mostly Priced In; Downgrade to Neutral 
CITI'S TAKE 
We downgrade Poya to Neutral from Buy following its strong YTD share price 
performance. Although operating momentum remains positive in the near-
term (we expect a strong Sep SSSG and solid 3Q earnings), we believe the 
rally has already reflected much of the benefit from robust SSSG YTD and 
margin expansion. Looking ahead, tough comparisons from 4Q26E may 
make solid SSSG harder to sustain, limiting earnings upside and potential 
weighing on stock sentiment. Meanwhile, Cosmed’s expanding rollout of 
Olive Young brands adds to competition pressure for beauty spending. We 
trim our DCF-based TP to NT$70, implying 18x NTM P/E vs. 5-year mean of 
17x. We view current risk/reward as balanced. 
Strong performance leaves less room for further upside — Poya’s shares have 
rallied 73% YTD, outperforming the benchmark’s 57% gain and broadly flat 
performance for the TW retail sector. This reflects strong operating deliver, including 
6-7% YTD SSSG and solid margin expansion supported by op leverage and 
headcount optimization. While the company may continue to grow earnings through 
store expansion and productivity improvements, we believe much of this outlook is 
already priced in. Further share price appreciation may require additional earnings 
upside, which could become more difficult to deliver if SSSG moderates. 
Tougher comp from 4Q26E could temper SSSG momentum — Poya’s YTD SSSG 
has benefited from 4-5% ticket growth, partly reflecting price inflation, as well as 
traffic growth 1-2%. We expect the comp base to become more demanding from 
4Q26E onward, increasing the hurdle for keeping the current growth rate. Slower 
SSSG could reduce incremental op leverage and limit further margin expansion. 
Given its YTD rally, a shift to positive but slower growth could weigh on sentiment. 
Cosmed’s Olive Young rollout raises competition pressure — Cosmed introduced 
four Olive Young, Korea’s leading beauty retail channel, proprietary brands in late 
Dec 2025 and planned to expand dedicated sections to 120 stores by end-2026E 
( ~20% of Cosmed’s total store count), increasing local access to popular Korean 
beauty products. Per Cosmed, PSD at locations carrying OY brands increased by 
MSD y/y YTD vs. MSD y/y down across its overall network, suggesting the brands are 
gaining customer interest. We believe broader availability and product selection 
could intensity competition for customer visits and beauty spending, potentially 
slowing Poya’s traffic growth and increasing promotional pressure.  (continued)

Poya (5904.TWO): Positives Mostly Priced In;
Downgrade to Neutral
Implications — We keep our earnings estimates largely unchanged for 2026-
2028E yet we trim our DCF-based TP to NT$70 from prior NT$74.5 mainly to factor
in a lower terminal growth of 4.5% (down from 5%). We also factor in its stock split
in Aug 2026. Our target price of NT$70 implies an 18x NTM forward P/E vs its 5-
year historical mean of 17x, which looks balanced to us.

We believe Poya’s store expansion and efficiency improvements may continue to
support earnings, but we see limited scope for further re-rating given the earnings
growth moderation (net profits +9% y/y in 2027E vs. +27% y/y in 2026E based on
our estimate) and its strong share-price gains to date. T ougher comparisons and
rising competition add uncertainty around the durability of SSSG momentum and
margin expansion.
We would prefer to see sustained traffic growth through the higher comp base,

clearer evidence of additional earnings upside or a more attractive entry point
before becoming more positive on the shares.

6
Poya
Company description
Poya is the largest retailer of fast-moving consumer goods in Taiwan, focusing
on low-priced cosmetics, accessories, clothing and food products for females
aged 15-49. Poya had 470 stores in Taiwan at the end of 2025 and believes
that the market can accommodate up to 700-800 stores before reaching
saturation.
Investment strategy
We have a Neutral rating on Poya. We think YTD rally has baked in most

positives, including strong SSSG and solid margin expansion. While
fundamentals remain solid, tougher comparisons from 4Q26E could
moderate this year's 6-7% SSSG, lowering operating leverage and capping
further earnings upside. Meanwhile, Cosmed's expanding rollout of Olive
Young brands is intensifying competition for beauty spending. Although
Poya's SSSG has remained resilient, braoder distribution of these brands
could divert customer traffic and increase promotional pressure. We continue

to recognize Poya's execution in store expansion and ongoing efficiency
improvements. However, with these strengths largely reflected in the share
price and growth momentum facing a higher hurdle from 4Q26E onward, we
see a more balanced risk/reward.
Valuation
We derive our 12-month target price of NT$70 for Poya from a DCF valuation
method. Our assumptions include a terminal growth rate of 4.5% and WACC
of 10.1% (beta of 1.05; risk-free rate of 4%; risk premium of 7.0%; cost of equity

of 11.3%). Our target price implies a P/E of 18x on our NTM EPS.
Risks
Key downside risks that could mean the shares fail to achieve our target price
include: intense price competition among online retailers, slower store traffic,
margin dilution due to aggressive store expansion, and a soft macro
environment.
Key upside risks that could mean the shares fail to achieve our target price
include: easing price competition among online retailers, stronger store

traffic, margin expansion thanks to strong cost control, and a stronger macro
environment.

Guide to Citi Research Fundamental Research Investment Ratings:
Citi Research stock recommendations include an investment rating and an optional risk rating to highlight high risk stocks.

Risk rating takes into account both price volatility and fundamental criteria. Stocks will either have no risk rating or a High risk
rating assigned.
Investment Ratings: Citi Research investment ratings are Buy, Neutral and Sell. Our ratings are a function of analyst
expectations of expected total return ("ETR") and risk. ETR is the sum of the forecast price appreciation (or depreciation) plus
the dividend yield for a stock within the next 12 months.  The target price is based on a 12 month time horizon. The Investment

rating definitions are: Buy (1) ETR of 15% or more or 25% or more for High risk stocks; and Sell (3) for negative ETR. Any covered
stock not assigned a Buy or a Sell is a Neutral (2). For stocks rated Neutral (2), if an analyst believes that there are insufficient
valuation drivers and/or investment catalysts to derive a positive or negative investment view, they may elect with the approval
of Citi Research management not to assign a target price and, thus, not derive an ETR. Citi Research may suspend its rating

and target price and assign “Rating Suspended” status for regulatory and/or internal policy reasons. Citi Research may also
suspend its rating and target price and assign "Under Review" status for other exceptional circumstances (e.g. lack of
information critical to the analyst's thesis, trading suspension) affecting the company and/or trading in the company's
securities. In both such situations, the rating and target price will show as “—“ and “-“ respectively in the rating history price

chart. Prior to 11 April 2022 Citi Research assigned “Under Review” status to both situations and prior to 11 Nov 2020 only in
exceptional circumstances. As soon as practically possible, the analyst will publish a note re-establishing a rating and
investment thesis. Investment ratings are determined by the ranges described above at the time of initiation of coverage, a
change in investment and/or risk rating, or a change in target price (subject to limited management discretion). At times, the

expected total returns may fall outside of these ranges because of market price movements and/or other short-term volatility
or trading patterns. Such interim deviations will be permitted but will become subject to review by Research Management.
Your decision to buy or sell a security should be based upon your personal investment objectives and should be made only
after evaluating the stock's expected performance and risk.
Catalyst Watch/Short Term Views (“STV”) Ratings Disclosure:

Catalyst Watch and STV Upside/Downside calls: Citi Research may also include a Catalyst Watch or STV Upside or Downside
call to indicate the analyst expects the share price to rise (fall) in absolute terms over a specified period of 30 or 90 days in
reaction to one or more specific near-term catalysts or events impacting the company or the market. A Catalyst Watch will be
published when Analyst confidence is high that an impact to share price will occur; it will be a STV when confidence level is

moderate. A Catalyst Watch or STV Upside/Downside call will automatically expire at the end of the specified 30/90 day
period. The Catalyst Watch will also be automatically removed if share price performance (calculated at market close) exceeds

### Page 3

We see several indicators suggesting strong ABF equipment demand, including (1) the 
lead time for ABF vacuum laminators has extended into 2031, implying ~1.5k units of 
mid-to-high end equipment orders (assuming UTR is full for Eternal Precision’s capacity 
in both Japan and China throughout 2027-31), vs. ~600 units of total equipment 
shipped during 2022-25. This suggests demand for ABF equipment is strengthening 
(even stronger than previous upcycle in 2020-22) and shifting toward higher-end 
(management mentioned that the four major Taiwanese ABF customers mainly ordered 
the 90-ton 3-stage vacuum laminators for new capacity expansions), (2) Eternal 
Precision has seen some customers voluntarily offer to pay a premium to secure 
equipment supply and shorten the long lead time, a trend that was not observed by the 
company during the last upcycle, and (3) contract liabilities uptrend has just started 
(Exhibit 2), and we expect to see even stronger growth in coming years considering the 
upcoming ABF substrate industry capacity expansion trend (from 2027 to at least 2031, 
Exhibit 3) 
The extended order lead time for the key ABF equipment supports our positive view on 
the ABF substrate industry. ABF suppliers remain proactive in capacity expansion, but 
demand continues to outpace supply, thus we expect the shortage ratio of ABF 
substrates could reach 14%/34%/51% in 2H26/2027/2028 (see here). We see limited 
risk from capacity expansion by China ABF suppliers due to their limited access to new 
ABF equipment. Eternal Precision has seen some China ABF customers offering 
premiums to shorten equipment lead time, but the company mentioned that they 
prioritize major customers, as well as those with secured ABF film supply (we continue to 
see limitations on ABF film supply for China ABF suppliers). Meanwhile, more 
end-customers are asking key ABF suppliers for capacity beyond 2029, consistent with 
the fact that major ABF suppliers have better access to key ABF equipment. 
In terms of future substrate products, Unimicron previously mentioned that MP 
shipment of EMIB-T substrates could start in 2027 (see here). While Japanese ABF 
suppliers will be the first to have access to the new ABF vacuum laminators for EMIB-T 
substrates given their better production yields, Unimicron is tracking close by targeting a 
50% yield for this new product. For the more advanced glass core substrates, we 
continue to see Kinsus and Unimicron making progress with this new technology (see 
here and here), while commercialization is unlikely in the near term (beyond 2029 per 
GSe). Overall, we believe that the most advanced packaging substrates could become a 
key revenue/GM driver in the longer term given their better pricing/margin profile (most 
advanced packaging substrates typically have GM of 60%+ upon MP vs. 
Kinsus/Unimicron GM at 26.1%/24.8% as of 2Q26). 
Maintain our Buy ratings on NYPCB (on CL) and Kinsus, but stay Neutral on Unimicron, 
with unchanged 12m TPs for NYPCB/Kinsus/Unimicron of 
NT$2,500/NT$1,125/NT$1,220.  
Investment Thesis & PT methodology and risks

Investment Thesis - NYPCB 
NYPCB manufactures and markets printed circuit boards (PCBs) and integrated circuit 
(IC) substrates (including ABF and BT substrates). We are Buy-rated on NYPCB

### Page 4

considering the company’s high exposure to BT substrates and non-LTA ABF substrate
(70%+ of total revenue), where we expect GM/OPM to increase significantly in the
coming quarters (from breakeven in OPM in 1H25 to 27/41% in 2026/27E) due to the
favorable substrate pricing outlook. Despite the company’s low exposure to high-end
ABF substrate industry (<20% of total revenue in 1H25), we believe the expanding
demand from ASIC AI server and high-end switch IC demand will drive the company’s

high-end ABF revenue exposure to 40%+ by 2027E, suggesting better GM/OPM outlook
in the long term. In 2H25-2H26, we believe NYPCB will continue to benefit from stronger
ABF/BT pricing and should be a key beneficiary of the pricing uptrend considering the
company’s key focus on BT and non-LTA ABF substrate industries. Moreover, in the long
term (after 2026), we expect the ABF industry to return to supply tightness, and NYPCB’s
expanding high-end exposure will lead to a long-term earnings growth outlook (122%

2026-28E earnings CAGR). As a result, we see solid upside potential for NYPCB’s
earnings and stock performance.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - NYPCB
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$2,500 for NYPCB is based
on 21x 2028E P/E, which is +1.5x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E (13.3x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, and (3)

Slower-than-expected NYPCB new high-end capacity qualification progress.
Investment Thesis - Kinsus
Kinsus is one of the key IC substrates suppliers globally with ~10% ABF/BT substrates
market share in 2024, with ~18% of total 2025 revenue contributed by its contact lens
subsidiary, Pegavision (6941.TW, Not Covered). With our view that the ABF substrate
shortage started from 2Q26 (ABF substrate return to supply demand balance from late
2025), we believe Kinsus’ performance will continue to improve compared with high-end

ABF peers considering the company’s increasing market share in the high-end ABF
substrate market; however, ~36% of the company’s revenue was contributed by BT
substrates in 2025 and 30% of the company’s ABF revenue is from non-LTA customers,
which we believe will continue to enjoy a better pricing outlook. As a result, we believe
Kinsus’ earnings outlook should continue to be strong (~106% 2026-29E CAGR), mainly
driven by better BT substrate and non-LTA ABF substrate pricing outlook, despite the

unfavorable demand outlook before 2H26. We believe Kinsus is an experienced
substrate supplier with a clear capacity expansion plan that can also upgrade its product
portfolio in the long term. We believe we are at the beginning of an industry upcycle,
making us positive on Kinsus’ stock performance over the next 12 months.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Kinsus
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,125 for Kinsus is based on

16.5x 2028E P/E, which is +1.2x STDV higher than Kinsus’ past upcycle average P/E
(14.2x).
Key downside risks: (1) Slower-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower-than-expected ABF substrates pricing upgrading outlook, (3)
Slower/Less-than-expected AI server orders from 2H26.

### Page 5

Investment Thesis - Unimicron Technology
Unimicron is a key supplier of ABF substrates (25% market share in 2025) and BT
substrates and also produces FPC/HDI/PCB products. We are Neutral rated on the
shares given long-term growth opportunity prospects: (1) over 70% of ABF shipments
are covered by long-term agreements (LTA), which limits pricing flexibility and makes
price hike less likely; (2) the company’s execution track record has been weaker than

peers; (3) capacity expansion plan remains slower than peers, constraining its ability to
capture incremental AI demand. The current ABF substrates market is seeing more
favorable supply demand outlook, and Unimicron is likely to see better pricing outlook
to reflect rising material costs in the coming quarters. AI ABF account for 10% of the
company’s total revenue, but the growth is likely to be slower than peers due to the
company continuing to lose market share to peers given its less favourable production

yield and slow capacity expansion. Overall, we are Neutral rated on Unimicron given our
outlook for limited upside potential, barring ASIC AI servers, despite our generally
positive view in the long term on its profitability trajectory.
Price Target Risks and Methodology - Unimicron Technology
Valuation methodology: Our 12-month target price of NT$1,220 for Unimicron is
based on 17.4x 2028E P/E, which is 2.7x STDV higher than the past upcycle average P/E

(10.3x).
Key upside/downside risks: (1) Slower/faster-than-expected PC demand recovery, (2)
Slower/faster-than-expected ABF substrates upgrading pace, and (3) Slower/faster
than-expected AI server PCB market share loss progress.

 投資評價與建議 
研究部維持中立建議：2H26 受惠 GB300 系列水冷散熱相關產品出貨增加，以及
AWS Trainium3及輝達 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產品開始出貨，逐漸增添貢獻。
Trainium3 4Q26 主要為小量產階段，預期主要貢獻放量將落在 2027 年。雙鴻目
前正在驗證輝達 Vera Rubin 世代水冷板，預計最快 9 月底通過驗證，待驗證完成
後進一步加入營收獲利貢獻預估。 
隨著 AI 伺服器散熱需求越來越高，不論 GPU、ASIC 散熱設計都越趨複雜，也加
大投資需求，對獲利率表現形成挑戰。水冷散熱供應者眾，目前水冷散熱零組件市
場以奇鋐及 Cooler Master 產能較大及佔據主要份額。雙鴻營運主要能受惠整體
水冷散熱滲透率、市場產值提升，帶動營收規模擴大及獲利金額成長。 預估雙鴻
2026 年、2027 年水冷散熱營收比重 59%、68%，稅後 EPS 56.93 元、79.87 元。

雙鴻為台灣散熱模組廠商，主要提供風扇、散熱片、熱導管等設計組合而成散熱工
具，裝置在筆記型電腦、桌上型電腦、伺服器及智慧型手機等產品。高速運算晶片
發熱量持續增加， 散熱管理重要性提升。 散熱管理技術過往以主被動混合式熱管理
方案(鰭片+風扇)為主 ， 近年主流設計為均熱板 、 熱導管及3DVC 的散熱解決方案 ，
伺服器應用客戶積極導入水冷式散熱解決方案，六大關鍵零組件包含 Cold Plate、
CDU(Cooling Distribution Units)、Rack、RDHx、Quick Connectors、Manifold。 
雙鴻生產基地位於泰國、中國廣州、昆山、重慶、合肥。台灣散熱模組廠主要競爭
對手為奇鋐、Cooler Master、台達電、超眾及力致等等。客戶包括國內外筆電品
牌大廠及台灣 ODM 代工廠。2Q26 產品組合：PC 17%，VGA 4%，Server 78%，
Others 1%。 
水冷營收比重持續提高：先前雙鴻公告 7 月自結獲利，單月營收 37.7 億元，稅前
淨利 8.3 億元，稅後淨利 6.0 億元，稅後 EPS 6.47 元，優於預期，主因 7 月認列
部份 6 月遞延營收。8 月份客戶拉貨波動，單月營收月減 16.6%，預期 9 月份將
會回升。3Q26 雙鴻 GB300 水冷板、Manifold 出貨增加，以及預期 9 月份 AWS 
Trainium3 及輝達 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產品開始出貨，逐漸增加貢獻，主要
貢獻將落在 4Q26。 
研究部推估雙鴻 3Q26、4Q26 水冷營收比重達 61％、63%。營收分別為 103 億、
109 億元。水冷營收比重增加，同時增強獲利率表現，預估毛利率分別為29.9%、
30.3%，稅後 EPS 16.77 元、17.14 元。 
認證輝達 Vera Rubin 水冷板中 ：雙鴻目前正在驗證輝達 Vera Rubin 世代水冷板 ，
預計最快 9 月底通過驗證。研究部認為短期雙鴻出貨 Vera Rubin 世代相關水冷產
品將先以 Manifold 為主，待驗證完成後進一步加入營收獲利貢獻預估。同時雙鴻
也有望延續進入 Vera Rubin Ultra 專案，待後續相關水冷產品開發。 
ASIC 方面，雙鴻將量產 AWS Trainium3 水冷相關產品包含水冷板、 Inner 
Manifold、Rack Manifold，惟 4Q26 主要為小量產階段，預期主要貢獻放量將落
在 2027 年。後續包含 Meta ASIC 及 CDU 產品都有望額外增添貢獻雙鴻水冷營
收。 
產能持續擴充 ， 主要受惠水冷市場產值擴大 ：公司積極拓展伺服器水冷散熱市場機
會，2026 年、2027 年持續增加伺服器水冷產品產能。目前水冷板月產能包含廣州
及泰國共 400k pcs， 後續視情況在泰國增加100k~200k pcs。Manifold 台灣 2k、
泰國 3k。隨著 AI 伺服器散熱需求越來越高，不論 GPU、ASIC 散熱設計都越趨複
雜，如無塵室等級要求提高，也加大投資需求，對獲利率表現都會形成挑戰。 
水冷散熱供應者眾，目前水冷散熱零組件市場以奇鋐及 Cooler Master 產能較大
及佔據主要份額。雙鴻營運主要能受惠整體水冷散熱滲透率、市場產值提升，帶動
營收規模擴大及獲利金額成長。預估雙鴻 2026 年、2027 年水冷散熱營收比重
59%、68%。2026 年營收 385 億元，年增 65%，毛利率 29.6%，營益率 17.8%，
稅後 EPS 56.93 元。2027 年營收 513 億元，年增33%，毛利率 18.6%，稅後 EPS 
79.87 元。

壹、投 資 建 議

一. CPU 續強外， ADAS 開始貢獻， 2H26 營運正向  
創意 2Q26 因 NRE 進入 Tape-out 及 Turkey 明顯出貨，使雲端相
關產品 (包括 Compute 、Connectivity) 佔營收比重達 80%，消費性
產品、記憶體、虛擬貨幣合計佔約 20% ，帶動 2Q26 整體營收達
138.97 億元， QoQ+21.39% ，YoY+127.64% ，毛利率因 Turkey
大幅上升而由 1Q26 的 27.2% 下滑至 21.55% ，稅後 EPS 11.61
元，合計 1H26 稅後 EPS 23.89 元，符合預期。

2H26 北美客戶 CPU 持續放量出貨，帶動 7、8 月平均單月營收約
58 億元，優於預期，使雲端產品營收比重維持在 80% 左右，加上
來自於北美、大陸、台灣的車用產品貢獻上升，取代大部份虛擬
貨幣的下滑，使 2H26 營收獲利加速， 2026 年呈現逐季成長的營
運走勢 ， 且在費用維持穩定(僅研發費用增加 )下 ， 我們預估創3Q26
營收 169.57 億元， QoQ+22.02% ，YoY+96.87% ，將優於市場預
期的 QoQ+10%， 單季稅後EPS 14.37 元，預 估4Q26 營收 222.36
億元， QoQ+31.13% ，YoY+79.33% ，稅後 EPS 19.42 元(因客戶
拉貨需求強勁，預估其中一個月的單月營收將創新高 )。

二. CPU 第二代產品將於 4Q26 ～1Q27 Tape-out 
創意除了車用產品將開始開花結果 ， 中系客戶於2H26 開始出貨，
美系客戶亦將於 2H27 開始出貨貢獻營收，且美系客戶的營收貢
獻將遠大於中系客戶 ， 預估將使創意車用營收比重由2026 年的個
位數百分比提升至 2027 年的雙位數百分比 ， 營收呈現超過倍數成
長，為 2027 年營運成長兩大動能之一；創意 CPU 客戶的第一代

年產能的取得將優於 2026 年，推動創意營收獲利顯著成長。

四. 投資建議買進，目標價 7881 元 
2026 年在在 CSP 及 AI 量產貢獻大幅成長的帶動下，營收及獲利
將呈現明顯跳升的表現，且因 CSP 客戶的下一代晶片訂單也已確

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介  
創意 (3443) 成立於 1998 年 ， 目前台積電持有35% 的股份 。 創意主
要以提供客戶特殊應用積體電路 (ASIC) 設計服務，包括 Spec-in
和系統單晶片整合 (SoC Integration) 、實體設計 (Physical 
Design) 、先進封裝技術 (Advanced Packaging Technology) 、量產
服務、 HBM 及 die-to-die 互連 IP，可應用於人工智慧 (AI) 、高速
運算 (HPC) 、5G / 網路、固態硬碟 (SSD) 和工業領域等市場。在先
進製程面臨摩爾定律極限後，半導體技術轉向利用先進封裝來增
加晶片的效能，使得先進封裝的發展重要性大幅提升，創意電子
亦專注於先進封裝技術的研發，包括 CoWoS，InFO 和 3D SoIC ，
滿足客戶各種需求。

二.營運概況及展望  
1、ASIC 產業重要性日益提升 
10/2022 年微軟推出 ChatGPT ，為科技產業帶來新的亮點，生成
式 AI 的新體驗，驚豔全球使用者，開啟各種終端產品導入 AI 的
功能，以提升產品效能及消費者使用滿意度，對廠商的正面幫助
是可因此提升產品 /製造的內含價值，提升公司獲利能力。由於 AI
的發展需要依靠規格較高、算力較強的伺服器來實現卓越的效
能，帶動 AI Server 建置的風潮。 AI Server 效能的展現端賴 GPU
強大的平行運算效能加上 AI 加速器的應用來強化 AI 功能的表
現，而 AI Server 算力模型的建置風潮，帶動高效能的 GPU 晶片
呈現供不應求的情況，在奇貨可居的情形下，使得原本價格就相
當高昂的晶片 GPU 晶片 ， 價格更是水漲船高 ， 促使建置AI Server
的國際大廠 Amazon 、Google 、Microsoft 、Meta 等，以及新創半
導體 IC 設計公司，紛紛展開研發自有晶片的行動，期以自研晶片
來取代高昂的 GPU 晶片，來降低成本，且保有設計自主性及產品
異化，使得特殊應用積體電路 (ASIC) 產業的重要性日益提升，除

由於創意擁有 IP、良好的設計服務及投片量產經驗，以及與晶圓

CoWoS 的商機將大幅成長 ， 創意可望獲得相關技術產品的營收貢
獻。

叁、業 績 及 獲 利 預 估

1、預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 14.37 元 
2H26 北美客戶 CPU 持續放量出貨， 7、8 月平均單月營收約 58
億元，優於預期，使雲端產品營收比重維持在 80% 左右，加上來
自於北美、大陸、台灣的車用產品貢獻上升，取代大部份虛擬貨
幣的下滑，使 2H26 營收獲利加速， 2026 年呈現季季增的營運走
勢，且在費用維持穩定 (僅研發費用增加 )下，我們預估創 3Q26 營
收 169.57 億元， QoQ+22.02% ，YoY+96.87% ，將優於市場預期
的 QoQ+10% ，單季稅後 EPS 14.37 元，預估 4Q26 營收 222.36
億元， QoQ+31.13% ，YoY+79.33% ，稅後 EPS 19.42 元(因客戶
拉貨需求強勁，預估其中一個月的單月營收將創新高 )。

2、預估 2026/2027 年稅後 EPS 57.68/131.35 元 
2026 年虛擬貨幣仍持續貢獻營收，但在雲端相關的產品放量生產
帶動下，營收獲利將明顯跳升，我們預估創意 2026 年整體營收達
645.38 億元 ，YoY+89.03% ， 毛利率22.2%，稅 後 淨 利77.3 億元，
YoY+105.06% ，稅後 EPS 57.68 元。在 CPU 及車用產品大幅貢
獻的帶動下，我們預估創意 2027 年整體營收 1,363.47 億元，
YoY+111.27% ，毛利率 21.16% ，稅後淨利 176.02 億元，
YoY+127.71% ，稅後 EPS 131.35 元。

股價相對大盤走勢

氣立 (4555 TT)  Trading Buy

考量 3Q26 動能仍佳、新產品效應，評等 Trading Buy 。  
投資建議 ：由於台灣、中國市場分別受惠於半導體封測、夾爪
類 /大型過濾器等訂單數量增加， 3Q26 氣立營收展望仍佳，加上
超音波流量感測器、靈巧手的長線潛在營收動能均可期，故群
益對氣立的投資建議為 Trading Buy 。  
2Q26 稅後淨利 0.45 億元， QoQ+1691.81% ：受惠於氣動元件出
貨暢旺， 2Q26 營收 4.92 億元， QoQ+21.19% ，毛利率則受惠於
產品組合優於 1Q26 而提高至 32.95% ，故營業利益增加至 0.36
億元， QoQ+333.28% ，此外，業外表現則因 0.19 億元處分子公
司利益而轉佳，稅後淨利 0.45 億元， QoQ+1691.81% 。  
3Q26 營收動能優於 2Q26 ：近期上海松江廠、台北泰山廠的產
能利用率分別為 80~85% 、接近 80%，觀察氣立在手訂單狀況，
3Q26 氣動元件營收展望仍佳 ， 浙江平湖廠產能利用率則自 3Q25
迄今均滿載，預估 3Q26 亦然，群益預估， 3Q26 氣立營收
QoQ+6.16% ，惟預估 4Q26 營收將因淡季效應而較 3Q26 減少。  
若就長線潛在營收動能而言，則以超音波流量感測器、靈巧手
較可期，其中，超音波流量感測器初期以液冷散熱、半導體廠
務為目標市場，目前已通過客戶認證，且自 2Q26 季末開始出
貨，後續亦再計畫拓展水資源、生技醫療、自動化設備等垂直
市場，此外，氣立亦將超音波流量感測器、電動球閥搭配成流
量感測模組，並預計自 2027 年開始出貨，若確成真，則對推升
氣立營收規模的助益程度將較大。  
氣立的靈巧手除原有的 3 指產品外，亦已推出 5 指產品，產品
線更形完整，初期鎖定的終端應用為工業機器人、協作機器人，
後續並計畫擴及人形機器人。若就有機會出貨的訂單來源而言，
首先，氣立現已送樣至台灣半導體大廠認證，最快 2027 年開始
出貨，其次，浙江平湖廠為中國系統業者代工人形機器人外殼
機構件，亦有機會成為靈巧手的訂單來源。

就強化能源、水資源管理而言，氣立現階段主要動作有三， (1) 製程多採用氣
動或電動等未使用直接排放大量溫室氣體之設備，且在採購相關設備初即
會選擇具有變頻節能功能之設備， (2) 氣立泰山廠區已全面改採 LED 照明設
備並汰換老舊生產設備，以降低用電度數， (3) 氣立泰山廠區透過水塔維修
及管線改善以降低用水度數。  
就供應鏈管理而言，氣立已建立完善的供應商稽核及評鑑制度，且每年均會
針對台灣供應商進行實地評鑑，以確保供應商在產品、品質、技術、環安衛
等項目符合法規及氣立本身的要求，且未來氣立亦持續朝強化永續供應鏈
的方向前進。  
受惠於氣動元件需求增溫、處分子公司利益， 2Q26 稅後淨利 0.45 億元，
QoQ+1691.81% ：  
氣立為氣動元件廠，上市同業為亞德客 -KY(1590 TT) ，由於氣立產能不及亞
德客 -KY，成本控制、零組件採購能力亦相對遜色，不過，氣立乃提升產品
價格競爭力並積極拓展少量多樣的利基型產品市場 (相關產品通常原由日、
德同業供應，氣立價格競爭力相對較佳，至於亞德客 -KY 爭取訂單的意願則
因訂單數量較小而偏低 )，故仍得以持續擴大出貨規模。  
氣立已在台北泰山、上海松江、浙江平湖 (以壓鑄等上游製程為主，產品毛
利率相對較低 )、泰國等 4 地設廠，產品包括氣缸、電磁閥、機械夾爪、真
空處理元件等，此外，亦推出電控產品。而氣立產品的終端應用領域涵蓋電

中，電子業近幾年營收比重均居冠，達 25~35% ，相關消費性電子產品終端
市場需求榮枯為氣立營運狀況的重要觀察指標；通用機械業近幾年營收比
重為 10~15% ，為氣立穩定的訂單來源，至於其餘垂直市場近幾年的營收比
重則均低於 5%。  
氣立產品的主要銷售地區為中國、台灣，近幾年營收比重分別為 65~90% 、
10~20% ，換言之，中國製造業景氣為影響氣立出貨表現影響甚鉅。氣立除

氣立的靈巧手除原有的 3 指產品外，亦已推出 5 指產品，產品線更形完整，

人。若就有機會出貨的訂單來源而言，首先，氣立現已送樣至台灣半導體大
廠認證，最快 2027 年開始出貨，其次，浙江平湖廠為中國系統業者代工人
形機器人外殼機構件，亦有機會成為靈巧手的訂單來源。

由於台灣、中國市場分別受惠於半導體封測、夾爪類 /大型過濾器等訂單數
量增加， 3Q26 氣立營收展望仍佳，加上超音波流量感測器、靈巧手的長線

【投資評等調整機制】  
  投資評等係「首次」給予特定個股投資評等時，其前一日收盤價相較 3 個月

爾後的投資評等係依循「首次評等」，直到停止推薦。   
「強力買進」、「買進」及「區間操作」均有 upside 目標價。差別僅在於，
首次評等時潛在報酬率不同。「中立」則無目標價。  
一旦我們給予特定個股「強力買進」 、 「買進」或「區間操作」之投資評等，
就是責任的開始，爾後將透過各式研究報告作定期性、持續性追蹤基本面及
股價變化，直到停止推薦。  
停止推薦情境：  
1.  達目標價。  
2.  雖未達原訂目標價，但檢視基本面、訊息面、籌碼面等多方訊息，研
判股價上漲空間已然有限，將適時出具降評報告。  
3.  推薦後股價不漲反跌。

6147 頎邦(Chipbond)

報告日期： 2026/09/10  研 究 員：翁浩軒 (Davy Wong) 
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 矽光子成為公司新成長動能 
頎邦近年拓展非面板類業務，並逐步在矽光子領域見到效益，公
司矽光子業務主要負責跨阻放大器（TIA） 、光檢測器（PD）、驅動
IC（Driver）、調變器（Modulator）等四大元件的金凸塊封裝，隨
著光收發模組傳輸朝單通道 200G 推進，對訊號品質、雜訊容忍度
及傳輸距離縮短之要求增加，金凸塊逐步取代傳統打線封裝進行
光電訊號轉換。除了金凸塊外，公司亦提供後續測試及切割業務，
預估今年矽光子營收比重 5%，2027 年營收亦將倍數成長，營收比
重將達 15~20%。

二.  2026 年毛利率改善，預估全年 EPS 5.65 元 
展望 2026 下半年，進入傳統手機出貨旺季，儘管記憶體漲價影響
全球手機出貨量，但公司美系大客戶今年新機預期仍具一定規
模，而矽光子業務隨光通訊傳輸需求爆發將明顯放量。今年在調
整價格加上矽光子業務逐步貢獻下預估毛利率較去年明顯提升。
預估頎邦 2026 年營收 275.35 億(YoY+28.34%)，稅後淨利 42.1 億
(YoY+51.68%)，EPS 5.65 元。

三. 2027 年矽光子業務帶動營收創高，預估 EPS 9.62 元  
展望 2027 年，受惠於 AI 資料傳輸對光通訊需求爆發，光收發模
組出貨量倍增，加上單通道 200G 滲透率提升，帶動公司矽光子金
凸塊營收倍數成長。傳統的 DDIC 業務方面，雖然消費性市場預期
仍不樂觀 ， 不過韓系 DDIC 廠轉移重心 ， 將 DDIC 之封裝業務釋出
予頎邦，整體 DDIC 業務仍將成長。預估頎邦 2027 年營收 340.53
億(YoY+23.67%)，稅後淨利 71.6 億(YoY+70.09%)，EPS 9.62 元。

四. 投資建議：買進，目標價 250 元  
頎邦為全球金凸塊封裝大廠，儘管全球消費性產品出貨量下滑，
不過公司受惠於韓系客戶之轉單，加上矽光子爆發帶動金凸塊需
求，今明年營運正向。考量到 1)公司在矽光子光電轉換之金凸塊
封裝具關鍵領導地位、 2)產品組合及稼動率提升帶動獲利率改善、
3)矽光子占比增加有助評價調升 ， 參考 2027 年 EPS 給予 26 倍本益
比，目標價 250 元，建議買進。

貳、公 司 營 運 概 況

一.公司簡介 
頎邦科技成立於 1997 年 7 月，為半導體封裝與測試服務供應商，
提供顯示器驅動 IC 後段封裝及測試代工服務 ， 主要從事凸塊(金凸
塊及錫鉛凸塊)之製造銷售並提供後段捲帶式軟板封裝(TCP) 、 捲帶
式薄膜覆晶(COF)、玻璃覆晶封裝(COG)之服務，產品主要應用於
LCD 驅動 IC ，近年亦跨入非 LCD 驅動 IC 業務，包括光通訊、RF、
RFID 等。2025 年產品組合：DDIC 60%、RFID 20%、RF 3%、其他
17%。主要客戶包括聯詠、瑞鼎、奇景、瑞薩、矽創等。公司為全
球第一大驅動 IC 封裝公司，驅動 IC 封裝領域方面，主要競爭對
手包括南茂、LB Semicon、Nepes 等。

二.2026 年營運概況及 2027 年展望 
1.矽光子成為公司新成長動能 
頎邦近年積極拓展非面板類業務 ， 並逐步在矽光子 、 射頻前端 （RF 
front-end）晶片與無線射頻辨識（RFID）三大領域見到效益，尤其
矽光子受惠於 AI 光通訊需求，成為成長最快之領域。公司矽光子
業務主要負責跨阻放大器 （TIA）、 光檢測器 （Photodetector ； PD） 、
驅動 IC （Driver）、 調變器 （Modulator） 等四大元件的金凸塊封裝，
隨著光收發模組傳輸朝單通道 200G 推進，對訊號品質、雜訊容忍
度及傳輸距離縮短之要求增加，金凸塊逐步取代傳統打線封裝進
行光電訊號轉換。過去金凸塊市場因價格競爭使得市場多家供應
商退出，而頎邦在非面板 DDIC 業務投入多年，亦有較大規模產
能，因此受惠此波矽光子需求爆發。目前公司在單通道 200G 之
TIA 、PD 金凸塊為主要供應商，而 Driver 、Modulator 產品研發中，
Driver 將於 1Q27 開始量產 ， 針對未來單通道 400G 採用 TFLN(薄膜
鈮酸鋰)材料，公司亦已投入工程研發，有望於 2028 年貢獻。另外
為滿足客戶一站式生產需求，除了金凸塊外，公司亦提供後續測
試及切割業務，唯測試設備交期較長，短期產值增加有限。預估
今年矽光子營收比重 5% ，2027 年營收亦將倍數成長，營收比重將
達 15~20%。

2. 2Q26 毛利率大幅跳升，EPS 1.28 元 
頎邦 2Q26 營收 66.32 億(QoQ+15.23%、YoY+23.44%)，受惠於進入
傳統電子備貨旺季，稼動率提升，加上漲價反應原料成本上揚，
單季營收創近四年新高，毛利率上揚至 30.3% ，主要因稼動率上揚
加上漲價因素，稅後淨利 9.5 億(QoQ+117.28%、YoY+131.56%)，
EPS 1.28 元。

3. 2026 年毛利率改善，預估全年 EPS 5.65 元 
展望 2026 下半年，進入傳統手機出貨旺季，儘管記憶體漲價影響
全球手機出貨量，但公司美系大客戶今年新機預期仍具一定規
模，非面板 DDIC 方面，RF 及 RFID 亦將穩定成長，而矽光子業務
隨光通訊傳輸需求爆發將明顯放量。今年在調整價格加上矽光子
業務逐步貢獻下預估毛利率較去年明顯提升。預估頎邦 2026 年營
收 275.35 億(YoY+28.34%)，毛利率 29.23%，稅後淨利 42.1 億
(YoY+51.68%)，EPS 5.65 元。

4. 2027 年矽光子業務帶動營收創高，預估 EPS 9.62 元 
展望 2027 年，受惠於 AI 資料傳輸對光通訊需求爆發，光收發模
組出貨量倍增，加上單通道 200G 滲透率提升，帶動公司矽光子金
凸塊營收倍數成長，此外客戶在單通道 400G modulator 亦有望量
產，公司將增加更多金凸塊製程產品。傳統的 DDIC 業務方面，雖
然消費性市場預期仍不樂觀，不過公司在市占率有所提升，韓系
DDIC 廠轉移重心至其他業務，將 DDIC 之封裝業務釋出予頎邦，
預估 2027 年第一季開始挹助營收 ， 韓廠業務將於 2027 年底完全轉
換完畢，因客戶量體大，將可彌補消費市場總出貨量下滑，整體
D D I C 業務仍將成長。預估頎邦 2027 年 營 收 340.53 億
(YoY+23.67%)，毛利率受惠於產品組合優化，加上產能吃緊價格
維持高檔而提升至 33.41%，稅後淨利 71.6 億(YoY+70.09%)，EPS 
9.62 元。

6907 雅特力-KY

報告日期： 2026/09/11 研 究 員：方姿婷  (Lesley Fang) 
壹、營 運 成 長

一、雅特力-KY 為專注 32 位元研發設計廠商，產品涵蓋
工控、車用與物聯網應用 
雅特力-KY(6907)為從事 32 位元微控制器(Microcontroller Unit，
MCU)之研發設計與銷售業務，產品廣泛應用於工業與馬達控制、
消費性電子、能源管理、商務設備、車載電子及物聯網等，雅特
力-KY 2Q26 產品應用別，Smart Home 佔 18%、AioT 佔 25%、Smart 
Industrial 佔 16%、Smart Mobility 佔 19%、Smart Business 佔 16%、
Others 佔 6% 。 雅特力-KY 之國際競爭對手為 STM 、 Microchip 、 TI、
NXP 、 Renesas 等廠商， 於大中華區之同業為中穎電子 、兆易創新、
芯海、新唐、松翰、九齊及應廣等。MCU 產業因應市場上的價格
競爭，刺激市場的補貼政策，營運自 2025 年起毛利率開始回穩，
顯示降價以去化庫存的影響性已降低，MCU 報價在數個季度調整
與中國廠商價格競爭壓力趨緩之下，價格壓力已經逐步減緩。展
望 MCU 市況，受到上游晶圓代工與後段封測的成本持續攀升，為
反應成本攀升、原物料(其中，包含被動元件電阻電容、塑料)等零
組件成本續增，MCU 於 2026 年 4 月、7 月逐步反應報價，主要反
應與轉嫁成本續增的壓力；雅特力-KY 成立初期即對標 32bits 
ARM-Based M4 以上產品線 ， 特點為 Memory Embeded(SRAM 、 Flash)
受到記憶體缺貨料源不足影響較少 。 雅特力-KY 的 32bit MCU 初期
與國際大廠 STMicro 相容(Compatible)設計，相容性高的產品，容
易切入市場量產，品項多元供應更具有彈性，避開與陸系廠商之
8bit、16bit、低階 M0 以下 32bit 相對紅海市場的競爭。

二、2026 年機器人市場需求提升，可望帶動營運成長 
雅特力-KY 擁有完整的馬達控制演算法與解決方案，是其關鍵的
競爭力。展望 2026 年，雅特力-KY 會聚焦於車載市場應用發展，
當前之車載應用領域，概略分為前裝和後裝市場。其中，前裝市
場皆會要求滿足 AEC-Q100 和功能安全認證 ， 而後裝市場則視部件
功能和客戶需求而定，以雅特力-KY 產品為例，多個產品型號均
已通過 AEC-Q100 車規可靠性認證，且於 2026 年初也取得了 ISO 
26262 ASIL-D 等級流程認證。對於雅特力-KY 從車用後裝市場跨
入前裝市場更為有利，亦成為雅特力-KY 進軍 Tier1 車廠之一新的
里程碑，在車載資通訊系統持續滲透車用市場趨勢帶動之下，車

器人關節強調快速反應和精密定位控制，中國機器人系統業者多
採用 MCU ，主訴其功率、扭力與性價比，均需要定位、轉速控
制，而雅特力-KY 的 MCU 設計以 M4 規格為核心，MCU 背後生態
系涵蓋馬達控制、Flash 記憶體容量更大、運算效能速度快、特定
網路通訊協議(CAN-FD)均為雅特力-KY 之強項，雅特力-KY 於電
機演算法之精進與生態系統建立，均樹立起雅特力-KY 在泛用機
器人應用領域佔穩一席之地。此外，機器人發展進程，雅特力-KY
於 2026 年 9 月 8 日，入列 Arm 全面設計(Arm Total Design)生態系
展示中。Arm 擴展至實體 AI(Physical AI)涵蓋 AI 模型、軟體、運
算硬體、感測器、虛擬平台及數位孿生領域，加速機器人、自駕
車等自主系統從概念驗證走向大規模部署。雅特力-KY 之產品，
對應機器人的行為、輸出與系統需求，足以涵蓋延遲、運算配置、
記憶體、功耗、確定性及安全性等指標，其中細項包含，即時控
制指節馬達、處理器編碼、執行角度速度及力矩閉環控制精密度
等功能，針對一雙機器人靈巧手搭載 40 顆+MCU，人形機器人搭
載 50~70 顆 MCU，對於雅特力-KY 產品組合優化均有助益。

三、邊緣型 AI 之 MCU 應用，為市場矚目之成長動能 
為因應邊緣型 AI 市場興起，雅特力-KY 指出在開發邊緣型 AI 應
用時開發環境也是相當重要的一環 ， 一般 MCU 供應商都需要提供
完整 AI 開發環境。2026 年雅特力-KY 將會推出 AI 開發工具，以
簡化建立 AI 模型時需要的資料蒐集和模型訓練工作，訓練完成
後，再利用此 AI 開發模型工具產生經過訓練的模型原始碼，並部
署到 MCU 中進行測試。邊緣型 AI 市場高階應用主要是以 SoC 為
主，用於串流影像處理和大語言模型等場合，如：手機的 SoC 具
備強大算力，可囊括大語言模型、影像處理、影像辨識和語音互
動等強大功能；相比之下 MCU 產品可著力於諸如：加速度計、壓
力、氣體、溫度、圖像等感測器相關應用，涵蓋工業、消費和醫
療應用等領域，例如；工廠中機器異常振動偵測、工具機刀具異
常磨損檢測等。為了進一步提升 MCU 在 AI 運算的效能，一般會
再搭載 N P U (神經網路處理單元)做為協處理器，例如:  A r m  
Ethos-U55，以提升 MCU 在 AI 推論時的效能，並進一步適用於更
多複雜的應用場合，例如：聲音內容與聲紋識別、圖像識別等。
雅特力-KY 已投入開發 28nm 製程之 AI MCU 系列產品，針對特殊

四、投資建議：買進，目標價 230 元 
雅特力-KY(6907)產品之競爭優勢為專注於 32 位元 MCU 當中屬於
中高階的 M4 規格核心，M4 核心運算效力為 M0 規格之 1.3 倍，大
部份 M0 支援頻率約為 48-64MHz ， 雅特力-KY 產品搭載 M4 核心多
數支援 120MHz 以上時脈，最高可支援至 288MHz，滿足高效能應
用需求。因此，雅特力-KY 產品以中高階市場 32 位元 M4 核心為
主，足以避開過度削價競爭的泛用型 MCU 市場。展望 2026 年，
雅特力-KY 之產品組合在車載、工控與 AI 相關應用逐步提升之
下，可望確立雅特力-KY 之長期營運成長動能，展望 2026 年，預
估雅特力-KY 營收為 35.62 億元 ， +213.81%YoY ， 毛利率為 39.03% ，
稅後淨利為 5.28 億元 ， 稅後 EPS+8.49 元 ； 展望 2027 年 ， 雅特力-KY
營運預估呈現雙位數增長，預估 2 7 年營收為 4 0 . 8 1 億元，
+ 1 4 . 5 7 % Y o Y，毛 利 率 為 4 0 . 7 1 %，稅 後 淨 利 6 . 3 1 億 元，稅 後 E P S + 1 0 . 1 4
元。綜合上述，給予雅特力-KY 投資建議為買進，目標價 230 元
(23.00x2027EPS)。

3. 成本占比極低，卻是高壓系統不可或缺的安全隔離元件 
繼電器透過小電流控制大電流 ， 並在控制端與高壓負載端之間提供
實體電氣隔離。過去低壓應用以家電與一般工控為主，單價多低於
1美元，客戶主要視其為成本元件。但隨系統電壓由 400V提升至
800V、1,500V，高壓遮斷與故障隔離的重要性大幅提高，繼電器與
接觸器逐步由一般控制元件轉為關鍵安全元件。以 800V HVDC AI 
伺服器機櫃為例，單櫃約使用12～36顆高壓繼電器，單價約20～30
美元，單櫃產值僅240～1,080美元，相較數百萬美元的機櫃成本占
比極低；800V電動車的高壓繼電器產值亦可達250美元以上，但占
整車成本仍不到1%。因此，對客戶而言繼電器的採購成本遠低於失
效可能造成的風險，加上高壓系統需符合安規並經過長期驗證，既
有供應商一旦導入後替換門檻高，價格敏感度相對有限。研究部認
為，繼電器過去因BOM占比低而長期被市場忽略，隨終端系統持續
高壓化，其安全價值、驗證門檻與單價皆同步提升，產業定位正由
低價零組件轉向高可靠度的關鍵安全元件。

4. 三大終端同步高壓化，規格升級推動ASP倍數成長 
繼電器ASP並非隨電流線性提升，而是隨電壓與遮斷能力升級呈現
倍數成長。傳統AC繼電器單價約0.5美元、AI PSU 約5～7美元，而
800V DC 及儲能接觸器可達20～30美元，反映高壓化帶來的規格與
安規門檻顯著提升。此一趨勢正同步發生於三大終端，電動車由
400V升至800V、儲能由1,000V升至1,500V，AI資料中心亦由低壓架
構朝400V／800V HVDC 演進，均落在松川既有高壓直流產品範圍。
以AI資料中心為例，HVDC架構雖可能降低單櫃繼電器顆數，但高壓
產品ASP可達傳統產品數十倍，單櫃產值反而提升；電動車方面，
隨800V平台滲透率提高，單車繼電器產值已由燃油車約 20～40美
元 、 早期電動車125～150美元 ， 提升至250美元以上 ； 儲能則隨5MW、
1,500V表前系統導入，持續拉高產品規格與單價。客戶端進度亦驗
證上述趨勢，松川為美系電動車大廠主要繼電器供應商，多數專案
採獨家供應，既有量產車款持續放量，後續並有望延伸至自駕計程
車應用；儲能方面，美系儲能大廠 2Q26部署量達13.5GWh（+53% 
QoQ），為歷史第二高，且上海廠稼動率持續提升、德州新廠仍在
建置，後續拉貨動能仍有望持續成長。松川深耕高壓直流技術逾十
年，產品涵蓋12V至1,500V，並可將電動車累積的滅弧、密封與高
壓設計能力延伸至AI電源與儲能應用 ， 具備跨終端共用技術平台的
優勢。

5. 競爭格局重組，松川憑高壓技術與非中產能搶奪市占 
全球繼電器產業正進入供應商重組期 ， 歐姆龍將含繼電器在內的元
件事業出售 ， 部分國際大型集團亦逐步縮減繼電器業務 ； 另一方面 ，
中系龍頭雖具規模優勢，但產能高度集中中國，在歐美客戶提高供
應鏈去中化與在地生產要求下，非中產能的重要性持續提升。松川
因此切入大型國際廠商投入意願較低 、 但技術與客製化門檻較高的
高壓市場，並受惠歐洲逆變器客戶轉單。近期研究部供應鏈訪查亦
顯示，公司已於主要 HVDC專案由第二供應商逐步提升至主要供應
商。相較規模型競爭者，松川優勢在於材料、產品設計與驗證能力
的垂直整合，公司自主掌握特殊塑料與銀合金接點，高壓直流產品
涵蓋12V至1,500V，接觸器規格可達400～500A；同時擁有自有IEC 
17025實驗室及嘉義高壓測試能力，零組件自製率達70～80%，自動
化設備亦由內部自行開發，有利縮短新品驗證與量產時程。此外，
公司自2018年起即布局台灣、墨西哥與越南，目前嘉義持續擴產、
墨西哥產線由1條增至4條，越南亦逐步轉向電動車、儲能與AI電源
等高階產品。研究部認為，在國際供應商退出、中系產能受地緣限
制 ， 以及高壓應用客製化程度持續提升下 ， 松川兼具高壓技術門檻 、
快速開發能力與非中產能布局，有望持續承接轉單並擴大全 球市
占。

6. 上修2026、2027年獲利預估 
受惠四大應用出貨動能優於預期，研究部上修 2026年營收預估由
94.33億元至98.28億元（+52.8% YoY） ，其中AI電源營收年增逾一
倍、電動車充電成長逾四成，帶動稅後EPS由12.48元上修至14.34
元（+324.8% YoY ）。展望2027年，HVDC產品自1Q27起逐步放量，
預估AI電源營收再成長約八成、營收占比提升至26%；電動車則受
惠高壓車款滲透率提升 ， 以及歐姆龍退出傳統汽車繼電器市場後的
轉單效應，帶動單車產值與市占同步提升。研究部因此上修2027年
營收預估由117.91億元至129.97億元（+32.2% YoY ），稅後EPS由
16.29元上修至20.03元（+39.7% YoY）。

公司簡介 
瀚荃成立於 1990 年，總部位於新北市淡水區，為全球知名的精密電子連接器、軟性
排線(FFC)與線纜組件製造大廠，公司以自有品牌 CviLux 行銷全球，近年成功從傳統
的個人電腦零組件廠商，轉型為跨足 AI 伺服器、低軌衛星、工業控制、車用電子等高
附加價值領域的關鍵零組件解決方案供應商。在海外佈局方面，公司的廠區包含中國
東莞、蘇州、重慶等，以及在東南亞的越南與寮國等地，目前公司將原定於蘇州廠生
產的筆電產能，逐步移往重慶廠生產，並規劃旗下的泰國廠於 2026 年底進行投產。
瀚荃在 2026 的營收結構當中，預估伺服器/網通比重 38%、筆電 18%、工業 17%、
汽車電子 3%、其他 14%。

展望 3Q26， 瀚荃最大的成長動能仍將來自AI 伺服器電源連接器與工業自動化相關需
求。公司具備高電流應用的特殊端子結構技術與專利，針對 DC 端所設計的板端連接
器可望受惠於客製化增加與複雜度上升，並持續透過與多家台系電源企業協同設計而

AI 電源成長動能強，800V HVDC 帶動板端連接器需求持續上升 
圖 2：AI 伺服器 800V DC 電源架構

資料來源：瀚荃法說會簡報、Digitimes 
當前部分 AI 伺服器供電仍採用 AC 電源架構，但隨著伺服器功耗突破千瓦級，傳統
AC 配電系統開始浮現轉換效率偏低與熱耗損攀升的技術瓶頸，而 800V HVDC( 高壓
直流電源)未來將逐漸普及，電流在進入白空間的機櫃後直接以 DC 形式傳送，以減少
AC 與 DC 之間的轉換次數，同時 PSU(電源供應器)、BBU(電池備援單元)與 CBU(電
容備援單元)等電力設備會逐漸從 Compute Rack 拆分成獨立的 Power Sidecar ，並
放置於背板或與匯流排連接，以釋出更多伺服器空間放置更多數量的其他電子元件。
連接器在傳統的伺服器內多為標準品， AC 市電端的連接器與線材由國外大廠如 TE 
Connectivity(TEL.US)與 Amphenol(APH.US)主導，但 DC 板端則由台廠的瀚荃所主
導，尤其是在次世代技術中，單一機櫃內的 PSU、BBU 與 CBU 等所需的板端連接器
數量將明顯提升，因此投研部預估公司 2026 年的網通/伺服器營收為 16.31 億元，
YoY+35%，佔總營收 38%，2026 年預估營收 43.39 億元，YoY+29.3%；因產品組
合 優 化 且 中 國 華 南 地 區 廠 房 產 線 整 合 的 情 況 下 ， 預 估 毛 利 率 將 上 升 至38% ，
YoY+0.6ppts； 營業利益率16.6%，YoY+3.2ppts； 稅後淨利率13.3%，YoY+3.2ppts；
稀釋後 EPS 7.37 元，YoY+87.1%。

報告日期： 2026/09/16 研 究 員：洪  國 峰 (Titan Horng)  
壹、投 資 建 議

一. 預估 3Q26 稅後 EPS 3.26 元 
柏文 07~08/2026 營收金額 6.26 億元與 6.22 億元， YoY+18.28%
與 16.75% ，MoM+4.03% 與-0.56% ，預估柏文 3Q26 營收金額
18.78 億元， YoY+17.41% ，QoQ+5.80% ，預估營業利益 3.50 億
元， YoY+51.34% ， QoQ+4.3% ，預估稅後盈餘 2.62 億元，
YoY+55.65% ，QoQ+1.02% ，預估稅後 EPS 3.26 元。

二. 預估 4Q26 稅後 EPS 3.53 元 
在新店集中在 4Q26 開幕，預估柏文 4Q26 營收金額 19.2 億元，
YoY+17.3% ， QoQ+2.28% ，預估營業利益 3.81 億元，
YoY+34.35% ， QoQ+8.92% ，預估稅後盈餘 2.84 億元，
YoY+29.01% ，QoQ+8.39% ，預估稅後 EPS 3.53 元。

三. 預計 2026 年稅後 EPS 12.40 元 
柏文 2026 年在同店成長與新點動能雙引擎帶動下 ， 單點會員人數
將會到疫情前水準，帶動柏文 2026 年營運持續成長。預估柏文
2026 年營收金額 72.00 億元， YoY+18.7% ，預估稅後盈餘 9.97
億元， YoY+49.68% ，預估稅後 EPS 12.40 元。

四. 預估 2027 年稅後 EPS 15.60 元 
柏文 2027 年在「新店動能」、「同店成長」及「會員二次消費增
加」三項成長動能帶動柏文 2027 年營收成長 ， 獲利方面受惠2026
年漲價效應逐漸顯現，獲利成長幅度將優於營收成長幅度。預估
柏文 2027 年營收金額 81.5 億元， YoY+13.2% ，預估稅後盈餘
12.54 億元， YoY+25.82% ，預估稅後 EPS 15.60 元。

五. 投資建議買進，目標價 200 元 
在疫情結束後，國內健身房產業大者恆大，經濟規模效益逐漸顯
現，柏 文2026 年獲利將回升至疫情前水準 ， 觀察柏文2016~2019
年 ROE 20~32% ，PER 14~45X ，柏文 2026 年 ROE39% ，PER 
12.9X ，2027 年 ROE 37% ，PER 10.3X ，評價偏低，加上統一健
身退出市場，柏文藉此吸收統一健身會員，有助評價提升，投資
建議買進，目標價 200 元。（ 16.1X 2026 年稅後 EPS ）

二. 公司簡介  
柏文健康事業成立於 2005 年，資本額 8.04 億元， 2016 年掛牌上
櫃，並於 2019 年轉上市。柏文主要經營會員制連鎖運動健身中心
與休閒運動場館，柏文為國內第二大連鎖健身中心，僅次於世界
健身（ World GYM ）。有別於其他同業，柏文遵循定型化契約預
收使用費 50% 信託收費標準化 、 透明化 ， 以減少與客戶消費糾紛，
柏文會員主要以月繳型會員為主 ， 其中月繳制會員高達 85~90% 、
其餘 10~15% 為預繳制會員。採用進口頂級器材、引進創新課程，
以提高月繳型會員續約率，柏文會員續約率高達 70~75% ，優於
歐美地區的 30~35% 水準。

三. 旗下品牌與全台據點概況  
柏文旗下品牌主要有健身工廠、兒童體適能俱樂部、肖跳、滾吧、
人體工房與鐳射戰場等六個事業體，其中主要以健身工廠為營運
主體，若以會費等級區分，主要分旗艦店、中型店與小型店。旗
艦店月費 1688 元(一般金卡會員 )；小型店月費 1088 元(一般金卡
會員 )；中型店月費 1288 元(一般金卡會員 )。

四. 2026 年營運概況及展望

柏文營收主要分健身及娛樂服務、運動保建服務、入會費收入、
其他等四部分。

預估 2026 年健身及娛樂服務營收金額 44.55 億元， YoY+19.8%

健身及娛樂服務，主要為每月會員繳交月費部分。健身及娛樂服
務 2025 年營收金額 37.18 億元， YoY+20.17% 。健身及娛樂服務
2025 年營收成長動能包括： 1，在會員續約率由 2024 年的 62%
提升至 2025 年目標 65% ，加上 2025 年新增 8~9 家據點，柏文
2025 年底會員人數將來到 35~36 萬人，增幅達 16~20% 。2，柏
文己在 2024 年調整會籍使用費 ，2Q25~3Q25 調整效益開始顯現 。

健身及娛樂服務 01~08/2026 營收金額 28.80 億元 ，YoY+21.06% 。 
預期 2026 年，在會籍使用費效益持續顯現，加上新增據點數持續
增加，推估 2026 年底會員人數有機會來到 42~43 萬人，增幅
15.4~18.1% ，宏遠預估健身及娛樂服務 2026 年營收金額 44.55
億元， YoY+19.8% 。

### Page 1

Value Play: High Voltage Setup at Discounted
Sentiment | GSTW
11 September 2026 | 2:55 PM Taiwan Standard Time
Robert Wang
Goldman Sachs (Asia) L.L.C. Taipei Branch
FICC & Equities
The index is taking a healthy breather with turnover thinning out as accounts sit on
their hands ahead of US CPI and next week’s FOMC (September hike odds still
hovering around 65–70%). Throw in retail liquidity getting tied up in the Hermes
Testing Solutions (7856 TT) IPO lockup, and the tape feels directionless.

Don't get me wrong, underlying sentiment is still bullish. Locals are whispering for 50k
points level in the coming weeks. But without fresh macro fuel to chase highs, it's
prime time to sift through the bargain bin. Yes, I am I'm a sales trader with a 5-second
attention span, but this mid-term value setup is too clean to ignore:
Trade Idea: Long Delta 2308 TT; GS TP NT$4,150
Investment Horizon: 3 - 6 Months
Investment Thesis:
Fundamental: Delta is still the leader in power management solutions for AI

servers. 800HVDC is the upcoming trend with meaningful revenue and margin
contribution starting 4Q26 and 2027. GS research expect GM/OPM will further
increase by 10ppt+/14ppt+ in 2028 vs. 2025, due to the increasing contribution
from AI power products (expand from 9% in 2025 to 69% in 2028E). To further
support this expansion, company has raised 2026 capex guidance to NT$70bn vs
NT$50bn before. The stock faced some short term noises on recent defect

capacitators chatter. However, per our supply chain check, the impact on the
fundamentals is slim, though the chatter definitely impacted short term sentiment.
Yet, this does not impact Delta's dominant and crucial position in AI supply chain.
Technical: As one the largest stocks listed in the exchange, Delta has
underperformed vs TWSE index since the end of Jul'26 rally and offers >50%
upside back to its 52-week high. Should the index rally further, the stock should

move along the same direction. Recent technical signals also suggest Oversold in
this name. On the qualitative side, we are seeing some bargain hunting in this name
at this level already.
Key Consideration: Stock at the moment lacks any significant re-rating catalyst
despite strong earnings and positive industry outlook and hence is used as a
funding short, just like TSMC (note that Delta has a very high short interest). The
upcoming earnings will likely guide upcoming quarter shipment and potentially

2027 outlook; thus, if the results are in-line to slight beat, short covering could
accelerate the rebound. However, as a downstream component supplier, any noises
on verification delays or design change may impact the short term sentiment, so
expect the rebound to be a bumpy ride.

垂直整合奠定長期競爭力 
投資與評價 
1. 2Q26 營收符合研究部先前預估，油價上漲影響顯示器業務利潤率表現
使毛利率季減。 
2. 展望 3Q26，預估在先進製程投片量逐漸成長下，營收將呈現季增趨
勢，毛利率因顯示器業務獲利率回穩、規模經濟效益發揮亦將季增。 
3. 隨 N3/N2 等新世代節點比例逐漸提升，新應材成長走勢也將更貼近大
客戶先進製程的推進節奏。研究部預估 2H26 營收將呈現逐季走高。 
4. 預估 FY26/27 EPS 分別為 15.42 元/23.17 元，YoY＋40.0%/+50.3%，
具有長期投資價值。研究部維持買進投資建議，惟考量近期市場波動，
將目標價調整至 850 元，以 37x FY27 獲利預估。 
重點更新 
2H26 營收獲利將呈現季季高，成長走勢逐漸貼近大客戶先進製程趨勢 
展望 2H26，研究部認為隨 N3/N2 等新世代節點比例逐漸提升，其放量效應
將更完整展現在整體營收與獲利表現上，成長走勢也將更貼近大客戶先進製
程的推進節奏。研究部預估營收將呈現逐季走高。獲利率方面，2Q26 受到油
價波動些微侵蝕顯示器業務獲利率，3Q26 原物料成本管理控制有成，顯示
器業務獲利率將逐漸回穩。 
新應材、新寶紘、昱鐳應材各擁優勢 
新應材目前正積極向先進製程與先進封裝兩大方向拓展產品版圖。 新應材亦
開始與策略夥伴新寶紘、昱鐳應材 （7932 TT） 攜手，分別鎖定不同站點協同
布局：新寶紘除既有產品外，新增翹曲控制膜與離形膜，聚焦於翹曲控制與
保護；昱鐳應材則由既有CCL 樹脂延伸至 Underfill、CPO、TGV 等新產品。
透過三方資源整合 ， 綜效逐漸顯現 ， 產品版圖持續由既有優勢領域向外延伸 。 
垂直整合奠定長期競爭力 
新應材與光阻劑日廠具有不同商業模式。以日廠信越化學為例，上游單體材
料由大阪有機、東洋合成等多家日商供應，有別於日本供應鏈將原料、純化、
配方由不同企業分工的模式，新應材具備垂直整合優勢，從原料至配方開發
皆自主掌握，在晶圓廠客戶對於即時服務要求逐漸提升，新應材可加快研發
與客製化開發進度，將彰顯出新應材之競爭優勢。

訪談內容 
預估 3Q26 營收獲利重回季增軌道 
2Q26 營收為 12.33 億元(QoQ-1.0%/YoY+6.9%)，符合研究部先前預估的 11.94 億元。營收些
微季減主要係因於 4 月因面臨客戶海外廠提前至 Q1 拉貨，且無客戶新廠洗線收入；毛利率優於
我們原先預估的 42.7%，達 44.5%(QoQ-0.9 ppts/ YoY-1.7 ppts)，油價上漲影響顯示器業務利
潤率表現使毛利率季減；EPS 達 3.28 元(QoQ-10.4%/ YoY+7.0%)，符合我們原先預估的 3.32
元。 
展望 3Q26，8 月因客戶海外廠新廠洗線帶動化學品需求，月營收明顯月增至 4.9 億元，研究部
預估在先進製程投片量逐漸成長下，3Q26 營收將呈現季增趨勢，研究部預估將達 13.28 億元
(QoQ+7.8%/YoY+24.7%)。預估毛利率因顯示器業務獲利率回穩、半導體業務規模經濟效益發
揮，季增至 45.8%(QoQ+1.3 ppts/ YoY+3.6 ppts)，EPS 為 3.97 元(QoQ+21.1%/ YoY+27.0%)。

2H26 營收獲利將呈現季季高，成長走勢逐漸貼近大客戶先進製程趨勢 
展望 2H26，研究部認為新應材成長動能來自於大客戶兩座 N2 新廠於今年投產，Rinse、BARC、
EBR 三項核心產品出貨量將隨 N2 產能爬坡逐季走高。由於新應材產品線橫跨 N40 至 N2 等全
部製程節點，過去在新舊製程產能互相消長下，整體成長力道容易被稀釋，難以顯著反映如 N2
單一世代放量的貢獻，隨 N3/N2 等新世代節點比例逐漸提升，其放量效應將更完整展現在整體
營收與獲利表現上，成長走勢也將更貼近大客戶先進製程的推進節奏。研究部預估營收將呈現逐
季走高。 
獲利率方面 ，2Q26 受到油價波動些微侵蝕顯示器業務獲利率 ，3Q26 原物料成本管理控制有成 ，
顯示器業務獲利率將逐漸回穩。在半導體業務方面，隨Rinse 出貨規模隨客戶整體產能成長而擴
大，剛打入 N2 製程的 BARC、EBR 將隨 N2 產能快速爬坡而同步放量 ， 毛利率亦有望逐步走升 。
整體而言，規模經濟效益將於 2026 年逐步顯現，預期 FY26 毛利率亦將逐季提升，成長幅度將
較營收成長更為顯著。 預估FY26 全年營收達 52.6 億元(YoY+23.4%)，毛利率達 45.4%(YoY+2.3 
ppts)，全年 EPS 為 15.42 元(YoY+37.0%)，全年獲利達歷史新高。

### Page 3

新應材、新寶紘、昱鐳應材各擁優勢 
新應材深耕黃光微影製程領域多年，目前正積極向先進製程與先進封裝兩大方向拓展產品版圖。
先進製程材料方面，至未來新製程節點將逐漸有新產品進入供應鏈。KrF/ArF 光阻劑研發進度符
合預期，可望切入A10 製程應用；既有 BARC 產品亦朝下一世代升級，除已放量的傳統版本外，
新一代產品將加入耐乾／濕蝕刻、高深寬比結構填孔及平坦化能力，使BARC 功能由單純抗反射
層，進一步延伸為兼具蝕刻保護與底層平坦化的複合型材料，目前亦正在驗證中。 
在先進封裝領域，公司產品布局已由前段特化材料延伸至晶圓薄化、切割及暫時鍵合等後段關鍵
製程，包括背面研磨保護層、雷射開槽電漿切割保護層、暫時鍵合膠等新品。新應材亦開始與策
略夥伴新寶紘、昱鐳應材（7932 TT）攜手合作，三方分別鎖定不同製程節點協同布局：新寶紘
除研磨膠帶、切割膠帶等既有產品外，新增翹曲控制膜（WCF）與離形膜（Release Film），聚焦
於載板翹曲控制與保護應用；昱鐳應材則由既有 CCL 樹脂延伸至 Underfill、CPO、TGV 及 Wafer 
Sealing Resin 等新產品，切入封裝填膠、光通訊與玻璃基板等領域。整體而言，新應材透過三
方資源整合、各自攻佔不同製程站點的分工布局，前段微影材料與後段封裝材料的綜效逐漸顯現，
產品版圖持續由既有優勢領域向外延伸。

垂直整合奠定長期競爭力 
新應材與光阻劑日廠具有不同商業模式。以日廠信越化學為例，上游單體材料由大阪有機、東洋
合成等多家日商供應，有別於日本供應鏈將原料、純化、配方由不同企業分工的模式，新應材具
備垂直整合優勢，從原料至配方開發皆自主掌握，在晶圓廠客戶對於即時服務要求逐漸提升，新
應材可加快研發與客製化開發進度，將彰顯出新應材之競爭優勢。 
研究部預估 FY26/27 EPS 分別為 15.42 元/23.17 元，YoY＋40.0%/+50.3%，新應材目前交易於
47/31 倍之 2026/2027 年獲利預估，過去歷史本益比區間為 50X~75X，具有長期投資價值。研
究部維持買進投資建議 ，惟考量近期市場波動 ，將目標價調整至 850 元 ， 以37x FY27 獲利預估 。

### Page 4

產業概況 
光阻周邊市場份額集中度高，台廠迎來新契機 
隨製程越演先進，在半導體微影製程中除了光阻劑本身外，另有一系列光阻周邊材料扮演關鍵角
色，包括表面改質劑 （Rinse） 、洗邊劑 （EBR） 、底部抗反射層 （BARC） 、頂部抗反射層 （TARC）、
稀釋劑 （Thinner） 以及光阻剝除劑 （Stripper） 等。根據研調機構Deloitte 及 WSTS 資料顯示，
2025 年全球黃光微影材料中，光阻及光阻周邊市場規模達67 億美元，預估至2030 年市場規模
將進一步成長至 96 億美元。除光阻劑市場規模增長，製程節點逐漸縮小，先進製程的高良率要
求亦推升對 Rinse、BARC 等提升良率材料的用量 ， 對於光阻周邊材料的材料精密度亦有所提升 。
光阻周邊材料市場集中度高 ， 主要由少數日 、 美 、 德大廠壟斷主要份額 ， 國外廠商如美商Merck、
美商杜邦、日商東京應化等。但在半導體在地化趨勢下，亦為台廠帶來新契機，相關廠商如新應
材(4749 TT)。

公司簡介 
新應材為台廠唯一光阻周邊產品供應商 
新應材股份有限公司成立於 2003 年，由面板光阻材料及清洗劑起家，自 2018 年開始轉型半導
體材料開發，聚焦對良率至關重要的微影（Lithography）特化材料，為台灣唯一在半導體微影
製程從原料合成、純化到配方自主設計，並持續擴大量產的特化材料廠。 
目前業務可分為 1) 半導體特化材料 ： 產品包括微影製程所需的表面改質劑(Rinse)、 洗邊劑(EBR)、 
清洗劑(Cleaner)、 顯影劑(Developer)、 底部抗反射層(BARC)等 ， 另有先進封裝材料及光學元件 。
2) 顯示器特化材料：產品包括顯示器用光阻劑、高/低折射率材料等。2024 年半導體特化材料
營收占比約八成，顯示器特化材料約兩成。 
生產基地方面，公司研發總部位於桃園龍潭，並在台南及高雄設有生產基地。台南廠為配方廠，
高雄一期則為合成及純化製程，高雄二期則涵蓋前段合成及純化以及後段的配方製程。

### Page 5

ESG 政策 
新應材由於 2024 年尚未達 20 億台幣資本額，目前尚未受到強制規範出具 ESG 報告書，預計將
於 2025 年 8 月開始出具 ESG 報告書。

⚫ 環境安全政策 
因產品、活動、服務過程中對人員健康安全危害及所產生的污染與能、資源之耗用對環境產生了
衝擊，為善盡社會之責任，我們將致力於危害、污染預防及持續改善，以降低各項製程及產品對
環境的危害，新應材公司已取得 ISO 45001 職安衛管理系統與 ISO 14001 環境管理系統認證，
定期執行內外部稽核，持續改善。

⚫ 節能減排政策 
新應材制定聚醯亞胺(PI) 溶液回收計劃。分離廢液中的 PI 及溶劑並同時再生及重覆使用，朝向
零液體排放前進 ， 大量減少焚燒處理後產生大量溫室氣體對環境的衝擊問題以及減少石化資源無
法再生循環使用的問題。新應材已榮獲重要晶圓代工客戶頒發「供應商節能減碳輔導專案」感謝
狀。

⚫ 綠色產品政策 
新應材為確保公司在全球供應鏈中不支持或助長任何形式的武裝衝突和人權侵犯 ， 並促進負責任
的採購行為。新應材承諾不使用並要求所有相關供應商配合禁用「來自衝突區域的金屬礦產」 。
新應材將對所有相關供應商進行盡職調查，確保其遵守新應材的政策。對於揭露資訊不完整或是
來自非合格熔煉廠者，新應材將持續督促其改善，並且不排除尋找其他供應商作為替代方案。

### Page 2

訪談內容 
2Q26 營收回升但原料與匯率壓抑毛利率 
2Q26 營收 55.54 億元（+32.1% QoQ） ，較原先預估上修9.3%，主要受惠 On-line 及 Off-line UPS 庫存回補，產
品組合中 On-line UPS 占 40.1%、Off-line UPS 27.6%、Inverter 22.8%，UPS 需求已逐步正常化，但 Inverter 仍
受中東地緣政治與價格競爭影響；毛利 14.04 億元，較原估下修6.7%，毛利率 25.3%較原估低 4.3 ppts，因 PCB、
被動元件及 PMIC 等材料成本上升，以及人民幣兌美元升值影響，其中材料成本估計壓抑毛利率約 2～3 ppts、匯
率影響約 1 ppt。營業費用 3.98 億元，較原估下修1.4%，費用率 7.2%，較原估低 0.8 ppts；營業利益 10.07 億元，
較原估下修 8.6%，營益率 18.1%，較原估低 3.5 ppts。業外損失 2.01 億元，雖匯兌損失約 2.1 億元但開較上季開
始收斂，稅後淨利 7.12 億元，較預估上修 8.7%，EPS 8.07 元為近半年新高。
